#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

vector<int> factorize(int p) {
    vector<int> factors;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= p; ++i) {
        if (p % i == 0) {
            factors.push_back(i);
            while (p % i == 0) p /= i;
        }
    }
    if (p > 1) factors.push_back(p);
    return factors;
}

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp % 2 == 1)
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp /= 2;
    }
    return result;
}

ll mod_inverse(ll a, ll mod) {
    a %= mod;
    return mod_pow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

ll comb_prime(ll n, ll k, ll p) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
    ll numerator = 1, denominator = 1;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        numerator = numerator * (n - k + i) % p;
        denominator = denominator * i % p;
    }
    return numerator * mod_inverse(denominator, p) % p;
}

ll lucas(ll n, ll k, ll p) {
    if (k == 0) return 1;
    ll np = n % p, kp = k % p;
    if (kp > np) return 0;
    return (lucas(n / p, k / p, p) * comb_prime(np, kp, p)) % p;
}

ll solve_crt(const vector<pair<ll, ll>>& congruences) {
    ll result = 0;
    ll mod_product = 1;
    for (auto& cong : congruences)
        mod_product *= cong.second;
    for (auto& cong : congruences) {
        ll m_i = mod_product / cong.second;
        ll inv = mod_inverse(m_i, cong.second);
        result = (result + cong.first * m_i % mod_product * inv % mod_product) % mod_product;
    }
    return result;
}

vector<pair<ll, ll>> compute_congruences(int n, int p, int l, int r, vector<int> primes) {
    vector<pair<ll, ll>> congruences;
    for (int q : primes) {
        int current_p = q;
        vector<ll> comb_table(n + 1);
        comb_table[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            comb_table[i] = comb_table[i - 1] * (n - i + 1) % current_p * mod_inverse(i, current_p) % current_p;

        auto comb = [&](int m, int a) {
            if (a < 0 || a > m) return 0LL;
            return lucas(m, a, current_p);
        };

        ll total = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c <= n; ++c) {
            int m = n - c;
            int s_min = max(l, 0);
            int s_max = min(r, m);
            if (s_min > s_max) continue;
            int a_low = max((s_min + m + 1) / 2, (m + 1) / 2);
            int a_high = min((s_max + m) / 2, m);
            if (a_low > a_high) continue;

            ll term = (comb(m, a_low) - comb(m, a_high + 1) + current_p) % current_p;
            ll ways_c = comb_table[c];
            total = (total + ways_c * term) % current_p;
        }
        congruences.emplace_back(total % current_p, current_p);
    }
    return congruences;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, p, l, r;
    cin >> n >> p >> l >> r;

    if (p == 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> primes = factorize(p);
    auto congruences = compute_congruences(n, p, l, r, primes);
    ll result = solve_crt(congruences);
    cout << result % p << endl;

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MAX_VAL = 100;

set<pair<int, int>> intervals[MAX_VAL + 1];

void merge_interval(int y, int L, int R) {
    auto& s = intervals[y];
    auto it = s.lower_bound({L, R});
    
    // Check previous interval
    if (it != s.begin()) {
        auto prev_it = prev(it);
        if (prev_it->second >= L - 1) {
            L = min(prev_it->first, L);
            R = max(prev_it->second, R);
            s.erase(prev_it);
        }
    }
    
    // Check next intervals
    it = s.upper_bound({L, R});
    while (it != s.end() && it->first <= R + 1) {
        R = max(R, it->second);
        it = s.erase(it);
    }
    
    s.insert({L, R});
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using Interval = pair<ll, ll>;

struct Compare {
    bool operator()(const Interval& a, const Interval& b) const {
        return a.first < b.first;
    }
};

set<Interval, Compare> intervals;

void add_interval(ll l, ll r) {
    auto it = intervals.lower_bound({l, l});
    if (it != intervals.begin()) {
        --it;
        if (it->second < l) {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    ll new_l = l, new_r = r;
    while (it != intervals.end() && it->first <= r) {
        new_l = min(new_l, it->first);
        new_r = max(new_r, it->second);
        it = intervals.erase(it);
    }
    intervals.insert({new_l, new_r});
}

void remove_interval(ll l, ll r) {
    vector<Interval> to_remove;
    auto it = intervals.lower_bound({l, l});
    if (it != intervals.begin()) {
        --it;
        if (it->second < l) {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    while (it != intervals.end() && it->first <= r) {
        to_remove.push_back(*it);
        ++it;
    }
    for (const auto& interval : to_remove) {
        intervals.erase(interval);
        ll a = interval.first, b = interval.second;
        if (a < l) {
            intervals.insert({a, l-1});
        }
        if (b > r) {
            intervals.insert({r+1, b});
        }
    }
}

void invert_interval(ll l, ll r) {
    vector<Interval> to_remove;
    auto it = intervals.lower_bound({l, l});
    if (it != intervals.begin()) {
        --it;
        if (it->second < l) {
            ++it;
        }
    }
    while (it != intervals.end() && it->first <= r) {
        to_remove.push_back(*it);
        ++it;
    }
    for (const auto& interval : to_remove) {
        intervals.erase(interval);
    }
    vector<Interval> to_add;
    ll prev = l;
    for (const auto& interval : to_remove) {
        if (interval.first > prev) {
            to_add.push_back({prev, interval.first - 1});
        }
        prev = interval.second + 1;
    }
    if (prev <= r) {
        to_add.push_back({prev, r});
    }
    for (const auto& interval : to_add) {
        intervals.insert(interval);
    }
}

ll find_mex() {
    auto it = intervals.upper_bound({1, LLONG_MAX});
    if (it != intervals.begin()) {
        --it;
        if (it->second >= 1) {
            ll current_end = it->second;
            ++it;
            while (it != intervals.end() && it->first == current_end + 1) {
                current_end = it->second;
                ++it;
            }
            return current_end + 1;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    while (n--) {
        ll t, l, r;
        cin >> t >> l >> r;
        if (t == 1) {
            add_interval(l, r);
        } else if (t == 2) {
            remove_interval(l, r);
        } else {
            invert_interval(l, r);
        }

    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    vector<string> grid(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> grid[i];
    }

    int si, sj, ti, tj;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'S') {
                si = i;
                sj = j;
            } else if (grid[i][j] == 'T') {
                ti = i;
                tj = j;
            }
        }
    }

    auto cmp = [](const State& a, const State& b) {
        if (a.steps != b.steps) {
            return a.steps > b.steps;
        } else {
            return a.path > b.path;
        }
    };
    priority_queue<State, vector<State>, decltype(cmp)> q(cmp);
    vector<vector<unordered_map<int, NodeInfo>>> visited(n, vector<unordered_map<int, NodeInfo>>(m));

    visited[si][sj][0] = {0, ""};
    q.push({0, "", si, sj, 0});

    const vector<pair<int, int>> dirs = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};

    while (!q.empty()) {
        State current = q.top();
        q.pop();

        int steps = current.steps;
        string path = current.path;
        int i = current.i;
        int j = current.j;
        int mask = current.mask;

        auto& node = visited[i][j][mask];
        if (steps > node.steps || (steps == node.steps && path > node.path)) {
            continue;
        }

        for (auto& dir : dirs) {
            int ni = i + dir.first;
            int nj = j + dir.second;
            if (ni < 0 || ni >= n || nj < 0 || nj >= m) {
                continue;
            }

            char cell = grid[ni][nj];
            if (cell == 'S') {
                continue;
            }

            if (cell == 'T') {
                cout << path << endl;
                return 0;
            }

            char c = cell;
            int new_mask = mask | (1 << (c - 'a'));
            int bit_count = __builtin_popcount(new_mask);
            if (bit_count > k) {
                continue;
            }

            int new_steps = steps + 1;
            string new_path = path + c;

            auto& next_node = visited[ni][nj][new_mask];
            if (new_steps < next_node.steps || (new_steps == next_node.steps && new_path < next_node.path)) {
                next_node.steps = new_steps;
                next_node.path = new_path;
                q.push({new_steps, new_path, ni, nj, new_mask});
            }
        }
    }

    cout << "-1" << endl;
    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

struct Config {
    bool is_row;
    pair<char, char> even_p;
    pair<char, char> odd_p;
    int even_start;
    int odd_start;
    int cost;
};

vector<pair<pair<char, char>, pair<char, char>>> pairings = {
    {{'A','G'}, {'C','T'}},
    {{'A','C'}, {'G','T'}},
    {{'A','T'}, {'C','G'}}
};

int compute_row_cost(const vector<string>& grid, const pair<char, char>& even_p, const pair<char, char>& odd_p, int even_start, int odd_start) {
    int cost = 0;
    int n = grid.size();
    int m = grid[0].size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            char expected;
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                if (j % 2 == 0) {
                    expected = even_p.first;
                } else {
                    expected = even_p.second;
                }
            } else {
                if (j % 2 == 0) {
                    expected = odd_p.first;
                } else {
                    expected = odd_p.second;
                }
            }
            if (expected != grid[i][j]) cost++;
        }
    }
    return cost;
}

int compute_col_cost(const vector<string>& grid, const pair<char, char>& even_p, const pair<char, char>& odd_p, int even_start, int odd_start) {
    int cost = 0;
    int n = grid.size();
    int m = grid[0].size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            char expected;
            if (j % 2 == 0) {
                if (i % 2 == 0) {
                    expected = even_p.first;
                } else {
                    expected = even_p.second;
                }
            } else {
                if (i % 2 == 0) {
                    expected = odd_p.first;
                } else {
                    expected = odd_p.second;
                }
            }
            if (expected != grid[i][j]) cost++;
        }
    }
    return cost;
}

Config find_best_config(const vector<string>& grid) {
    Config best;
    best.cost = INT_MAX;

    // Check row-wise candidates
    for (const auto& p : pairings) {
        const auto& p1 = p.first;
        const auto& p2 = p.second;
        for (int even_rev = 0; even_rev < 2; ++even_rev) {
            auto even_p = (even_rev == 0) ? p1 : p2;
            auto odd_p = (even_rev == 0) ? p2 : p1;
            for (int even_start = 0; even_start < 2; ++even_start) {
                pair<char, char> even_pair = { even_p[even_start], even_p[1 - even_start] };
                for (int odd_start = 0; odd_start < 2; ++odd_start) {
                    pair<char, char> odd_pair = { odd_p[odd_start], odd_p[1 - odd_start] };
                    int cost = compute_row_cost(grid, even_pair, odd_pair, even_start, odd_start);
                    if (cost < best.cost) {
                        best = { true, even_pair, odd_pair, even_start, odd_start, cost };
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Check column-wise candidates
    for (const auto& p : pairings) {
        const auto& p1 = p.first;
        const auto& p2 = p.second;
        for (int even_rev = 0; even_rev < 2; ++even_rev) {
            auto even_p = (even_rev == 0) ? p1 : p2;
            auto odd_p = (even_rev == 0) ? p2 : p1;
            for (int even_start = 0; even_start < 2; ++even_start) {
                pair<char, char> even_pair = { even_p[even_start], even_p[1 - even_start] };
                for (int odd_start = 0; odd_start < 2; ++odd_start) {
                    pair<char, char> odd_pair = { odd_p[odd_start], odd_p[1 - odd_start] };
                    int cost = compute_col_cost(grid, even_pair, odd_pair, even_start, odd_start);
                    if (cost < best.cost) {
                        best = { false, even_pair, odd_pair, even_start, odd_start, cost };
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return best;
}

vector<string> generate_grid(const Config& config, int n, int m) {
    vector<string> res(n, string(m, ' '));
    if (config.is_row) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (i % 2 == 0) {
                    res[i][j] = (j % 2 == 0) ? config.even_p.first : config.even_p.second;
                } else {
                    res[i][j] = (j % 2 == 0) ? config.odd_p.first : config.odd_p.second;
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (j % 2 == 0) {
                    res[i][j] = (i % 2 == 0) ? config.even_p.first : config.even_p.second;
                } else {
                    res[i][j] = (i % 2 == 0) ? config.odd_p.first : config.odd_p.second;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return res;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, cost;
    Edge(int t, int r, int c, int co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(co) {}
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> h, dist, prevv, preve;
    
    MinCostFlow(int size) : n(size), g(size) {}
    
    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        g[from].emplace_back(to, g[to].size(), cap, cost);
        g[to].emplace_back(from, g[from].size()-1, 0, -cost);
    }
    
    int compute(int s, int t, int f) {
        int res = 0;
        h.assign(n, 0);
        prevv.assign(n, -1);
        preve.assign(n, -1);
        
        while (f > 0) {
            priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> pq;
            dist.assign(n, numeric_limits<int>::max());
            dist[s] = 0;
            pq.push({0, s});
            
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, v] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (dist[v] < d) continue;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = g[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > d + e.cost + h[v] - h[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = d + e.cost + h[v] - h[e.to];
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (dist[t] == numeric_limits<int>::max()) return -1;
            
            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++)
                if (h[v] < numeric_limits<int>::max()) h[v] += dist[v];
            
            int d = f;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v])
                d = min(d, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            f -= d;
            res += d * h[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge& e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<string> s(n);

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<vector<int>> g;
vector<int> in, out, depth, tour;
vector<pair<int, int>> edges;
vector<int> initial_type;
vector<int> parent;

void dfs(int u, int p, int d) {
    in[u] = tour.size();
    tour.push_back(u);
    depth[u] = d;
    parent[u] = p;
    for (int e : g[u]) {
        auto& edge = edges[e];
        int v = edge.first ^ edge.second ^ u;
        if (v != p) {
            dfs(v, u, d + 1);
        }
    }
    out[u] = tour.size() - 1;
}

struct LazySegmentTree {
    int n;
    vector<bool> tree;
    vector<bool> lazy;

    LazySegmentTree(int size) : n(size), tree(size * 4, false), lazy(size * 4, false) {}

    void push(int node, int l, int r) {
        if (lazy[node]) {
            tree[node] = !tree[node];
            if (l != r) {
                lazy[node * 2] = !lazy[node * 2];
                lazy[node * 2 + 1] = !lazy[node * 2 + 1];
            }
            lazy[node] = false;
        }
    }

    void update_range(int node, int l, int r, int ul, int ur) {
        push(node, l, r);
        if (r < ul || l > ur) return;
        if (ul <= l && r <= ur) {
            lazy[node] = !lazy[node];
            push(node, l, r);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        update_range(node * 2, l, mid, ul, ur);
        update_range(node * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, ul, ur);
    }

    bool query_point(int node, int l, int r, int idx) {
        push(node, l, r);
        if (l == r) return tree[node];
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (idx <= mid) return query_point(node * 2, l, mid, idx);
        else return query_point(node * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, idx);
    }

    void flip(int l, int r) { update_range(1, 0, n - 1, l, r); }
    bool get(int idx) { return query_point(1, 0, n - 1, idx); }
};

struct Info {
    int even_dia, odd_dia;
    int even_max1, even_max2;
    int odd_max1, odd_max2;
    int e_to_e, e_to_o, o_to_o;
};

vector<Info> subtree_info;

void compute_subtree_info(int u, int p, const vector<int>& type) {
    int even_dia = 0, odd_dia = 0;
    int even_max1 = 0, even_max2 = 0;
    int odd_max1 = 0, odd_max2 = 0;
    int e_to_e = 0, e_to_o = 0, o_to_o = 0;

    for (int e : g[u]) {
        auto& edge = edges[e];
        int v = edge.first ^ edge.second ^ u;
        if (v == p) continue;
        compute_subtree_info(v, u, type);

        auto& child = subtree_info[v];
        int current_type = type[e];
        if (current_type) {
            swap(child.even_dia, child.odd_dia);
            swap(child.even_max1, child.odd_max1);
            swap(child.even_max2, child.odd_max2);
            swap(child.e_to_e, child.o_to_o);
            int temp = child.e_to_o;
            child.e_to_o = child.e_to_e;
            child.e_to_e = temp;
        }

        even_dia = max(even_dia, child.even_dia);
        odd_dia = max(odd_dia, child.odd_dia);

        if (child.even_max1 + 1 > even_max1) {
            even_max2 = even_max1;
            even_max1 = child.even_max1 + 1;
        } else if (child.even_max1 + 1 > even_max2) {
            even_max2 = child.even_max1 + 1;
        }

        if (child.odd_max1 + 1 > odd_max1) {
            odd_max2 = odd_max1;
            odd_max1 = child.odd_max1 + 1;
        } else if (child.odd_max1 + 1 > odd_max2) {
            odd_max2 = child.odd_max1 + 1;
        }

        e_to_e = max(e_to_e, child.e_to_e);
        e_to_o = max(e_to_o, child.e_to_o);
        o_to_o = max(o_to_o, child.o_to_o);
    }

    even_dia = max(even_dia, even_max1 + even_max2);
    even_dia = max(even_dia, e_to_e);
    odd_dia = max(odd_dia, odd_max1 + odd_max2);
    odd_dia = max(odd_dia, o_to_o);
    e_to_e = max(e_to_e, even_max1);
    e_to_o = max(e_to_o, max(even_max1, odd_max1));
    o_to_o = max(o_to_o, odd_max1);

    subtree_info[u] = {even_dia, odd_dia, even_max1, even_max2, odd_max1, odd_max2, e_to_e, e_to_o, o_to_o};
}

                max_row = rows[x];
                target_row = x;
            }
        }

                if (nx < 1 || nx > 999 || ny < 1 || ny > 999) continue;

                }
            }

        int best_dist = abs(best.first - target_row) + abs(best.second - target_col);
        for (auto &p : candidates) {

        rook_set.erase({old_x, old_y});

        cols[old_y]--;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 1) {
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int u) {
        if (parent[u] != u)
            parent[u] = find(parent[u]);
        return parent[u];
    }
    void unite(int u, int v) {
        u = find(u), v = find(v);
        if (u == v) return;
        if (rank[u] < rank[v]) swap(u, v);
        parent[v] = u;
        if (rank[u] == rank[v]) rank[u]++;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int r, c, n;
    cin >> r >> c >> n;

    vector<pair<int, int>> cells(n);
    vector<vector<bool>> in_input(r+1, vector<bool>(c+1, false));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int ri, ci;
        cin >> ri >> ci;
        cells[i] = {ri, ci};
        in_input[ri][ci] = true;
    }

    int total_cells = r * c;
    DSU dsu(total_cells + 2);
    const int TOP = 0;
    const int BOTTOM = 1;

    auto idx = [c](int i, int j) {
        return (i-1)*c + (j-1) + 2;
    };

    vector<vector<bool>> is_sea(r+1, vector<bool>(c+1, false));
    for (int i = 1; i <= r; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= c; ++j) {
            if (!in_input[i][j]) {
                is_sea[i][j] = true;
                if (i == 1) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), TOP);
                if (i == r) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), BOTTOM);
                if (i > 1 && !in_input[i-1][j]) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), idx(i-1, j));
                if (i < r && !in_input[i+1][j]) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), idx(i+1, j));
                int left_j = (j == 1) ? c : j-1;
                if (!in_input[i][left_j]) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), idx(i, left_j));
                int right_j = (j == c) ? 1 : j+1;
                if (!in_input[i][right_j]) dsu.unite(idx(i,j), idx(i, right_j));
            }
        }
    }

    if (dsu.find(TOP) == dsu.find(BOTTOM)) {
        cout << n << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    reverse(cells.begin(), cells.end());
    int steps = 0;

    for (auto& cell : cells) {
        int ri = cell.first, ci = cell.second;
        is_sea[ri][ci] = true;
        int current = idx(ri, ci);

        if (ri > 1 && is_sea[ri-1][ci]) dsu.unite(current, idx(ri-1, ci));
        if (ri < r && is_sea[ri+1][ci]) dsu.unite(current, idx(ri+1, ci));
        int left_ci = (ci == 1) ? c : ci - 1;
        if (is_sea[ri][left_ci]) dsu.unite(current, idx(ri, left_ci));
        int right_ci = (ci == c) ? 1 : ci + 1;
        if (is_sea[ri][right_ci]) dsu.unite(current, idx(ri, right_ci));

        if (ri == 1) dsu.unite(current, TOP);
        if (ri == r) dsu.unite(current, BOTTOM);

        steps++;
        if (dsu.find(TOP) == dsu.find(BOTTOM)) {
            cout << (n - steps) << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    cout << 0 << endl;
    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using vi = vector<int>;
using pii = pair<int, int>;
using Edge = tuple<int, int, int, int, int>; // v, u, c, t, idx

int n, m;

vector<vector<Edge>> color_edges;

bool check_high(int T, vector<unordered_set<int>>& v_high) {
    for (const auto& es : color_edges) {
        unordered_set<int> vertices;
        for (const auto& e : es) {
            int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), t = get<3>(e);
            if (t > T) {
                if (vertices.count(v) || vertices.count(u)) return false;
                vertices.insert(v);
                vertices.insert(u);
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

vector<Edge> get_mandatory(int T, vector<unordered_set<int>>& v_high) {
    vector<Edge> mandatory;
    for (int c = 0; c < color_edges.size(); ++c) {
        const auto& ces = color_edges[c];
        for (const auto& e : ces) {
            int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), t = get<3>(e);
            if (t > T) continue;
            if (v_high[c].count(v) || v_high[c].count(u)) {
                mandatory.push_back(e);
            }
        }
    }
    return mandatory;
}

bool is_matching(const vector<Edge>& edges) {
    unordered_set<int> used;
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e);
        if (used.count(v) || used.count(u)) return false;
        used.insert(v);
        used.insert(u);
    }
    return true;
}

vector<int> solve() {
    int left = 0, right = 1e9;
    vector<int> best;

    // Precompute color groups
    unordered_map<int, int> color_map;
    int color_cnt = 0;
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int c = get<2>(e);
        if (!color_map.count(c)) color_map[c] = color_cnt++;
    }
    color_edges.resize(color_cnt);
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int c = get<2>(e);
        color_edges[color_map[c]].push_back(e);
    }

    int best_T = -1;
    vector<int> best_S;

    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        vector<unordered_set<int>> v_high(color_cnt);
        bool valid = true;

        // Check E_high for each color
        for (int c = 0; c < color_cnt; ++c) {
            unordered_set<int> tmp;
            for (const auto& e : color_edges[c]) {
                int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), t = get<3>(e);
                if (t > mid) {
                    if (tmp.count(v) || tmp.count(u)) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    tmp.insert(v);
                    tmp.insert(u);
                }
            }
            if (!valid) break;
            v_high[c] = tmp;
        }
        if (!valid) {
            left = mid + 1;
            continue;
        }

        // Get mandatory_S and check if it's a matching
        vector<Edge> mandatory = get_mandatory(mid, v_high);
        if (!is_matching(mandatory)) {
            left = mid + 1;
            continue;
        }

        // Now process optional_S
        unordered_set<int> used_vertices;
        unordered_set<int> s_indices;
        for (const auto& e : mandatory) {
            int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), idx = get<4>(e);
            if (used_vertices.count(v) || used_vertices.count(u)) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
            used_vertices.insert(v);
            used_vertices.insert(u);
            s_indices.insert(idx);
        }
        if (!valid) {
            left = mid + 1;
            continue;
        }

        // For each color, process optional_S
        for (int c = 0; c < color_cnt && valid; ++c) {
            vector<Edge> optional;
            for (const auto& e : color_edges[c]) {
                int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), t = get<3>(e), idx = get<4>(e);
                if (t <= mid && !v_high[c].count(v) && !v_high[c].count(u)) {
                    optional.push_back(e);
                }
            }

            unordered_map<int, vector<int>> adj;
            unordered_set<int> curr_used;
            for (const auto& e : optional) {
                int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), idx = get<4>(e);
                if (used_vertices.count(v) || used_vertices.count(u)) {
                    s_indices.insert(idx);
                    used_vertices.insert(v);
                    used_vertices.insert(u);
                    curr_used.insert(v);
                    curr_used.insert(u);
                }
            }

            unordered_set<int> keep;
            for (const auto& e : optional) {
                int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e), idx = get<4>(e);
                if (s_indices.count(idx)) continue;
                if (curr_used.count(v) || curr_used.count(u)) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
                keep.insert(idx);
                curr_used.insert(v);
                curr_used.insert(u);
            }
            if (!valid) break;

            // Check if keep is a matching
            unordered_set<int> tmp;
            for (int idx : keep) {
                const auto& e = edges[idx-1];
                int v = get<0>(e), u = get<1>(e);
                if (tmp.count(v) || tmp.count(u)) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
                tmp.insert(v);
                tmp.insert(u);
            }
            if (!valid) break;
        }

        if (valid) {
            best_T = mid;
            best_S = vector<int>(s_indices.begin(), s_indices.end());
            right = mid - 1;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }

    if (best_T == -1) return {};

    // Verify and collect the answer
    vector<int> ans;
    ans.push_back(best_T);
    ans.push_back(best_S.size());
    ans.insert(ans.end(), best_S.begin(), best_S.end());
    return ans;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

struct Cut {
    int x1, y1, x2, y2;
};

pair<vector<int>, vector<int>> process_cuts(int n, int m, const vector<Cut>& cuts) {
    set<int> v, h;
    for (auto& c : cuts) {
        if (c.x1 == c.x2) { // vertical
            int x = c.x1;
            if (x > 0 && x < n) {
                v.insert(x);
            }
        } else if (c.y1 == c.y2) { // horizontal
            int y = c.y1;
            if (y > 0 && y < m) {
                h.insert(y);
            }
        }
    }
    v.insert(0); v.insert(n);
    h.insert(0); h.insert(m);
    vector<int> vv(v.begin(), v.end()), hh(h.begin(), h.end());
    sort(vv.begin(), v.end());
    sort(hh.begin(), h.end());
    return {vv, hh};
}

ll compute_total(const vector<int>& v, const vector<int>& h) {
    ll total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; ++i) {
        int w = v[i+1] - v[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < h.size() - 1; ++j) {
            int he = h[j+1] - h[j];
            total ^= (ll)(w-1) ^ (he-1);
        }
    }
    return total;
}

optional<tuple<int, int, int, int>> find_split(const vector<int>& v, const vector<int>& h, ll total) {
    for (int i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; ++i) {
        int x_start = v[i], x_end = v[i+1];
        int w = x_end - x_start;
        for (int j = 0; j < h.size() - 1; ++j) {
            int y_start = h[j], y_end = h[j+1];
            int he = y_end - y_start;
            ll g = (ll)(w-1) ^ (he-1);
            ll target = total ^ g;

            // Try vertical split
            if (w >= 2) {
                ll s = w - 2;
                ll d = target;
                if (s >= d && (s - d) % 2 == 0) {
                    ll and_mask = (s - d) / 2;
                    if ((d & and_mask) == 0) {
                        ll x = and_mask + d;
                        ll y = and_mask;
                        ll a = x + 1;
                        ll b = y + 1;
                        if (a >= 1 && b >= 1 && a + b == w) {
                            int cut_x = x_start + a;
                            return make_tuple(cut_x, y_start, cut_x, y_end);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Try horizontal split
            if (he >= 2) {
                ll s = he - 2;
                ll d = target;
                if (s >= d && (s - d) % 2 == 0) {
                    ll and_mask = (s - d) / 2;
                    if ((d & and_mask) == 0) {
                        ll x = and_mask + d;
                        ll y = and_mask;
                        ll a = x + 1;
                        ll b = y + 1;
                        if (a >= 1 && b >= 1 && a + b == he) {
                            int cut_y = y_start + a;
                            return make_tuple(x_start, cut_y, x_end, cut_y);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return nullopt;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    vector<Cut> cuts(k);
    for (auto& c : cuts) {
        cin >> c.x1 >> c.y1 >> c.x2 >> c.y2;
    }

    auto [vv, hh] = process_cuts(n, m, cuts);
    ll total = compute_total(vv, hh);

    if (total == 0) {
        cout << "SECOND\n";

            auto [x1, y1, x2, y2] = *res;
            cout << "FIRST\n";
            cout << x1 << ' ' << y1 << ' ' << x2 << ' ' << y2 << '\n';
        } else {
            cout << "SECOND\n";
        }
    }

    return 0;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    set<pair<int, int>> edges;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (u > v) swap(u, v);
        edges.insert({u, v});
    }

    // Check case B: all edges are loops, each node has <= 1 loop
    bool caseB = true;
    vector<int> loopCount(n + 1, 0);
    for (auto [u, v] : edges) {
        if (u != v) {
            caseB = false;
            break;
        }
        loopCount[u]++;
    }
    if (caseB) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (loopCount[i] > 1) {
                caseB = false;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> edgesB;
    if (caseB) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (loopCount[i] == 0) {
                edgesB.emplace_back(i, i);
            }
        }
    }

    // Check case A: edges form a subset of the lex smallest cycle
    bool caseA = false;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edgesA;
    if (n == 1) {
        // Only possible if all edges are loops (handled by case B)
        // So caseA is possible only if case B is possible
        caseA = caseB;
        if (caseA) {
            if (edges.empty()) {
                edgesA.emplace_back(1, 1);
            } else {
                edgesA.clear();
            }
        }
    } else {
        set<pair<int, int>> cycleEdges;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            cycleEdges.insert({i, i + 1});
        }
        cycleEdges.insert({1, n});

        bool valid = true;
        for (auto e : edges) {
            if (!cycleEdges.count(e)) {
                valid = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (valid) {
            caseA = true;
            for (auto e : cycleEdges) {
                if (!edges.count(e)) {
                    edgesA.push_back(e);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> resEdges;
    bool possible = false;
    string answer = "NO";

    if (caseA || caseB) {
        possible = true;
        answer = "YES";
        // Determine which case is better
        if (!caseB) {
            resEdges = edgesA;
        } else if (!caseA) {
            resEdges = edgesB;
        } else {
            if (edgesB.size() < edgesA.size()) {
                resEdges = edgesB;
            } else if (edgesA.size() < edgesB.size()) {
                resEdges = edgesA;
            } else {
                // Compare lex order
                if (edgesB < edgesA) {
                    resEdges = edgesB;
                } else {
                    resEdges = edgesA;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    if (possible) {
        cout << resEdges.size() << endl;
        for (auto [u, v] : resEdges) {
            cout << u << " " << v << endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct SegmentTree {
    int n;
    vector<int> tree;

    SegmentTree(int size) {
        n = 1;
        while (n < size) n <<= 1;
        tree.assign(2 * n, -1);
    }

    void update(int idx, int value) {
        idx += n;
        if (tree[idx] < value) {
            tree[idx] = value;
            for (idx >>= 1; idx >= 1; idx >>= 1) {
                int new_val = max(tree[2 * idx], tree[2 * idx + 1]);
                if (tree[idx] == new_val) break;
                tree[idx] = new_val;
            }
        }
    }

    int query(int l, int r) {
        l += n;
        r += n;
        int res = -1;
        while (l <= r) {
            if (l % 2 == 1) res = max(res, tree[l++]);
            if (r % 2 == 0) res = max(res, tree[r--]);
            l >>= 1;
            r >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    cin >> N;
    vector<int> B(N), I(N), R(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> B[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> I[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> R[i];

    vector<tuple<int, int, int>> ladies;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        ladies.emplace_back(B[i], I[i], R[i]);

    sort(ladies.begin(), ladies.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
        return get<0>(a) > get<0>(b);
    });

    vector<vector<tuple<int, int, int>>> groups;
    if (!ladies.empty()) {
        int current_B = get<0>(ladies[0]);
        vector<tuple<int, int, int>> current_group;
        for (const auto& lady : ladies) {
            if (get<0>(lady) == current_B) {
                current_group.push_back(lady);
            } else {
                groups.push_back(current_group);
                current_group.clear();
                current_B = get<0>(lady);
                current_group.push_back(lady);
            }
        }
        groups.push_back(current_group);
    }

    vector<int> all_I;
    for (const auto& lady : ladies)
        all_I.push_back(get<1>(lady));
    sort(all_I.begin(), all_I.end());
    all_I.erase(unique(all_I.begin(), all_I.end()), all_I.end());
    int m = all_I.size();

    SegmentTree st(m);
    int ans = 0;

    for (const auto& group : groups) {
        for (const auto& lady : group) {
            int i_val = get<1>(lady);
            int r_val = get<2>(lady);
            int idx = lower_bound(all_I.begin(), all_I.end(), i_val) - all_I.begin();
            if (idx + 1 < m) {
                int max_r = st.query(idx + 1, m - 1);
                if (max_r > r_val)
                    ans++;
            }
        }

        unordered_map<int, int> max_r_map;
        for (const auto& lady : group) {
            int i = get<1>(lady);
            int r = get<2>(lady);
            if (max_r_map.find(i) == max_r_map.end() || r > max_r_map[i])
                max_r_map[i] = r;
        }

        for (const auto& [i, r] : max_r_map) {
            int idx = lower_bound(all_I.begin(), all_I.end(), i) - all_I.begin();
            st.update(idx, r);
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

vector<ll> compute_prefix(const vector<int>& items) {
    vector<ll> prefix = {0};
    for (int x : items) {
        prefix.push_back(prefix.back() + x);
    }
    return prefix;
}

ll get_value(int R, int j, const vector<ll>& sum2, const vector<ll>& sum1, int cnt1) {
    if (j < 0 || j >= (int)sum2.size()) return 0;
    int remaining = R - 2 * j;
    if (remaining < 0) return 0;
    int take1 = min(remaining, cnt1);
    return sum2[j] + sum1[take1];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<int> w1, w2, w3;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int w, c;
        cin >> w >> c;
        if (w == 1) w1.push_back(c);
        else if (w == 2) w2.push_back(c);
        else w3.push_back(c);
    }

    sort(w1.rbegin(), w1.rend());
    sort(w2.rbegin(), w2.rend());
    sort(w3.rbegin(), w3.rend());

    vector<ll> sum1 = compute_prefix(w1);
    vector<ll> sum2 = compute_prefix(w2);
    vector<ll> sum3 = compute_prefix(w3);

    int cnt1 = w1.size();
    int cnt2 = w2.size();
    int cnt3 = w3.size();

    vector<ll> dp(m + 1, 0);

    for (int R = 0; R <= m; ++R) {
        ll case2 = 0;

        if (R >= cnt1) {
            int j_max_case2 = (R - cnt1) / 2;
            j_max_case2 = min(j_max_case2, cnt2);
            if (j_max_case2 >= 0) {
                ll s2 = sum2[j_max_case2];
                ll s1 = sum1[cnt1];
                case2 = s2 + s1;
            }
        }

        ll case1 = 0;

        int j_low = max(0, (R - cnt1 + 1) / 2);
        int j_high = min(R / 2, cnt2);

        if (j_low <= j_high) {
            int low = j_low;
            int high = j_high;
            int best_j = j_low;

            while (low <= high) {
                if (low == high) {
                    best_j = low;
                    break;
                }
                if (high - low == 1) {
                    ll val_low = get_value(R, low, sum2, sum1, cnt1);
                    ll val_high = get_value(R, high, sum2, sum1, cnt1);
                    if (val_high > val_low) {
                        best_j = high;
                    } else {
                        best_j = low;
                    }
                    break;
                }
                int mid = (low + high) / 2;
                ll val_mid = get_value(R, mid, sum2, sum1, cnt1);
                ll val_mid1 = get_value(R, mid + 1, sum2, sum1, cnt1);
                if (val_mid < val_mid1) {
                    low = mid + 1;
                } else {
                    high = mid;
                }
            }

            case1 = get_value(R, best_j, sum2, sum1, cnt1);
        }

        dp[R] = max(case1, case2);
    }

    ll max_total = 0;
    int max_c = min(cnt3, m / 3);
    for (int c = 0; c <= max_c; ++c) {
        int rem_weight = m - 3 * c;
        if (rem_weight < 0) break;
        ll current = sum3[c] + (rem_weight >= 0 ? dp[rem_weight] : 0);
        max_total = max(max_total, current);
    }

    cout << max_total << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    char c;
};

pair<bool, pair<int, vector<int>>> solve(int n, const vector<Edge>& edges, char target) {
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj(n + 1);
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int ci = (e.c != target) ? 1 : 0;
        adj[e.u].emplace_back(e.v, ci);
        adj[e.v].emplace_back(e.u, ci);
    }

    vector<int> color(n + 1, -1);
    vector<int> flips;
    int total = 0;
    bool possible = true;

    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        if (color[u] == -1) {
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(u);
            color[u] = 0;
            vector<int> component = {u};
            int sum = 0;
            bool ok = true;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int current = q.front();
                q.pop();

                for (const auto& p : adj[current]) {
                    int v = p.first;
                    int ci = p.second;
                    int expected = color[current] ^ ci;

                    if (color[v] == -1) {
                        color[v] = expected;
                        component.push_back(v);
                        sum += expected;
                        q.push(v);
                    } else if (color[v] != expected) {
                        ok = false;
                    }
                }
                if (!ok) break;
            }

            if (!ok) {
                possible = false;
                break;
            }

            int comp_size = component.size();
            int flip = min(sum, comp_size - sum);
            total += flip;
            bool invert = (sum > comp_size - sum);

            for (int x : component) {
                if ((color[x] == 1 && !invert) || (color[x] == 0 && invert)) {
                    flips.push_back(x);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (possible) {
        return {true, {total, flips}};
    } else {
        return {false, {0, {}}};
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<Edge> edges(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;

        edges[i] = {u, v, c};
    }

    auto [possible_b, res_b] = solve(n, edges, 'B');

    if (!possible_r && !possible_b) {
        cout << -1 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    pair<int, vector<int>> best;
    if (!possible_r) {
        best = res_b;
    } else if (!possible_b) {
        best = res_r;
    } else {
        if (res_r.first <= res_b.first) {
            best = res_r;
        } else {
            best = res_b;
        }
    }

    cout << best.first << '\n';
    for (size_t i = 0; i < best.second.size(); ++i) {
        if (i > 0) cout << ' ';
        cout << best.second[i];
    }
    cout << '\n';
    
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct TreapNode {
    int key, priority;
    long long sum;
    int size;
    TreapNode *left, *right;
    TreapNode(int key) : key(key), priority(rand()), sum(key), size(1), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
};

class Treap {
private:
    TreapNode* root = nullptr;

    void update(TreapNode* node) {
        if (node) {
            node->size = 1 + getSize(node->left) + getSize(node->right);
            node->sum = node->key + getSum(node->left) + getSum(node->right);
        }
    }

    int getSize(TreapNode* node) const {
        return node ? node->size : 0;
    }

    long long getSum(TreapNode* node) const {
        return node ? node->sum : 0;
    }

    void split(TreapNode* node, double key, TreapNode*& left, TreapNode*& right) {
        if (!node) {
            left = right = nullptr;
            return;
        }
        if (node->key <= key) {
            split(node->right, key, node->right, right);
            left = node;
        } else {
            split(node->left, key, left, node->left);
            right = node;
        }
        update(node);
    }

    TreapNode* merge(TreapNode* left, TreapNode* right) {
        if (!left) return right;
        if (!right) return left;
        if (left->priority > right->priority) {
            left->right = merge(left->right, right);
            update(left);
            return left;
        } else {
            right->left = merge(left, right->left);
            update(right);
            return right;
        }
    }

public:
    void insert(int key) {
        TreapNode *left, *right;
        split(root, key, left, right);
        root = merge(merge(left, new TreapNode(key)), right);
    }

    void remove(int key) {
        TreapNode *left, *mid, *right;
        split(root, key - 1e-9, left, right);
        split(right, key + 1e-9, mid, right);
        root = merge(left, right);
        if (mid) delete mid;
    }

    pair<int, long long> query(double T) {
        TreapNode *left, *right;
        split(root, T, left, right);
        int cnt = getSize(left);
        long long sum = getSum(left);
        root = merge(left, right);
        return {cnt, sum};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int n, q;
    cin >> n >> q;
    vector<int> h(n);
    Treap treap;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> h[i];
        treap.insert(h[i]);
    }
    while (q--) {
        int type;
        cin >> type;
        if (type == 1) {
            int p, x;
            cin >> p >> x;
            p--;
            treap.remove(h[p]);
            h[p] = x;
            treap.insert(h[p]);
        } else {
            long long vi;
            cin >> vi;
            double left = 0.0, right = 1e18;
            for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; ++iter) {
                double mid = (left + right) / 2;
                auto [cnt, sum] = treap.query(mid);
                double total = mid * cnt - sum;
                if (total >= vi) {
                    right = mid;
                } else {
                    left = mid;
                }
            }
            cout << fixed << setprecision(5) << right << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Fraction {
    int64_t num, den;

    Fraction(int64_t num = 0, int64_t den = 1) {
        if (den < 0) {
            num = -num;
            den = -den;
        }
        int64_t g = gcd(abs(num), abs(den));
        if (g != 0) {
            this->num = num / g;
            this->den = den / g;
        } else {
            this->num = 0;
            this->den = 1;
        }
        if (this->den == 0) {
            this->den = 1;
        }
    }

    bool operator==(const Fraction& other) const {
        return num == other.num && den == other.den;
    }

    bool operator!=(const Fraction& other) const {
        return !(*this == other);
    }

    Fraction operator-() const {
        return Fraction(-num, den);
    }

    Fraction operator+(const Fraction& other) const {
        return Fraction(num * other.den + other.num * den, den * other.den);
    }

    Fraction operator-(const Fraction& other) const {
        return *this + (-other);
    }

    Fraction operator*(const Fraction& other) const {
        return Fraction(num * other.num, den * other.den);
    }

    Fraction operator/(const Fraction& other) const {
        return Fraction(num * other.den, den * other.num);
    }

    string toString() const {
        if (den == 1) {
            return to_string(num);
        } else {
            return to_string(num) + "/" + to_string(den);
        }
    }

    static int64_t gcd(int64_t a, int64_t b) {
        a = abs(a);
        b = abs(b);
        while (b != 0) {
            int64_t temp = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
};

vector<vector<Fraction>> computeRREF(vector<vector<Fraction>> matrix, int cols) {
    int current_row = 0;
    int rows = matrix.size();
    for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        if (current_row >= rows) break;
        int pivot_row = -1;
        for (int r = current_row; r < rows; r++) {
            if (matrix[r][c] != Fraction(0, 1)) {
                pivot_row = r;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (pivot_row == -1) continue;
        swap(matrix[current_row], matrix[pivot_row]);
        Fraction factor = matrix[current_row][c];
        for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
            matrix[current_row][j] = matrix[current_row][j] / factor;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            if (i == current_row) continue;
            Fraction scale = matrix[i][c];
            if (scale != Fraction(0, 1)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j] - scale * matrix[current_row][j];
                }
            }
        }
        current_row++;
    }
    return matrix;
}

string getKey(const vector<vector<Fraction>>& canonical) {
    string key;
    for (const auto& row : canonical) {
        bool all_zero = true;
        for (const auto& x : row) {
            if (x != Fraction(0, 1)) {
                all_zero = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!all_zero) {
            if (!key.empty()) key += ";";
            bool first = true;
            for (const auto& x : row) {
                if (!first) key += ",";
                first = false;
                key += x.toString();
            }
        }
    }
    return key;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int m, d;
    cin >> m >> d;
    unordered_map<string, int> group_map;
    vector<int> groups;
    int next_group = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int k;
        cin >> k;
        vector<vector<Fraction>> matrix;
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            vector<Fraction> row;
            for (int l = 0; l < d; l++) {
                int a;
                cin >> a;
                row.emplace_back(a, 1);
            }
            matrix.push_back(row);
        }

        matrix = computeRREF(matrix, d);
        vector<vector<Fraction>> canonical;
        for (const auto& row : matrix) {
            bool all_zero = true;
            for (const auto& x : row) {
                if (x != Fraction(0, 1)) all_zero = false;
            }
            if (!all_zero) canonical.push_back(row);
        }

        string key = getKey(canonical);
        if (group_map.count(key)) {
            groups.push_back(group_map[key]);
        } else {
            group_map[key] = next_group;
            groups.push_back(next_group++);
        }
    }

    for (int g : groups) {
        cout << g << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

struct Element {
    string tag;
    vector<string> path;
};

vector<string> parse_tags(const string& s) {
    vector<string> tags;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < s.size()) {
        if (s[pos] != '<') {
            pos++;
            continue;
        }
        size_t end = s.find('>', pos);
        if (end == string::npos) break;
        string tag_content = s.substr(pos + 1, end - pos - 1);
        tags.push_back(tag_content);
        pos = end + 1;
    }
    return tags;
}

vector<string> split(const string& s, char delimiter) {
    vector<string> tokens;
    string token;
    istringstream tokenStream(s);
    while (getline(tokenStream, token, delimiter)) {
        if (!token.empty()) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
    }
    return tokens;
}

bool is_subsequence(const vector<string>& query, const vector<string>& path) {
    size_t i = 0;
    for (const string& tag : path) {
        if (i < query.size() && tag == query[i]) {
            i++;
        }
    }
    return i == query.size();
}

int main() {
    string document;
    getline(cin, document);
    
    list<Element> elements;
    stack<Element*> stack;
    unordered_map<string, vector<Element*>> tag_to_elements;

    vector<string> tags = parse_tags(document);
    
    for (const string& tag_content : tags) {
        if (tag_content.empty()) continue;

        bool is_closing = false;
        bool is_self_closing = false;
        string tag_name;

        if (tag_content[0] == '/') {
            is_closing = true;
            tag_name = tag_content.substr(1);
        } else if (tag_content.back() == '/') {
            is_self_closing = true;
            tag_name = tag_content.substr(0, tag_content.size() - 1);
        } else {
            tag_name = tag_content;
        }

        if (is_closing) {
            if (!stack.empty()) {
                stack.pop();
            }
        } else {
            Element new_elem;
            new_elem.tag = tag_name;

            if (!stack.empty()) {
                new_elem.path = stack.top()->path;
                new_elem.path.push_back(tag_name);
            } else {
                new_elem.path.push_back(tag_name);
            }

            elements.push_back(new_elem);
            Element* elem_ptr = &elements.back();
            tag_to_elements[tag_name].push_back(elem_ptr);

            if (!is_self_closing) {
                stack.push(elem_ptr);
            }
        }
    }

    int m;
    cin >> m;
    cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after m
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        string query_line;
        getline(cin, query_line);
        vector<string> parts = split(query_line, ' ');

        if (parts.empty()) {
            cout << 0 << endl;
            continue;
        }

        string last_tag = parts.back();
        auto it = tag_to_elements.find(last_tag);
        if (it == tag_to_elements.end()) {
            cout << 0 << endl;
            continue;
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (Element* elem : it->second) {
            if (is_subsequence(parts, elem->path)) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        cout << count << endl;
    }

    return 0;

vector<int> find_next_path(int n, int m, const vector<int>& original) {
    vector<multiset<int>> adj(n + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u = original[i], v = original[i + 1];
        adj[u].insert(v);
        adj[v].insert(u);
    }

    for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
        int current = original[k];
        int original_next = original[k + 1];
        vector<int> candidates;
        for (int neighbor : adj[current]) {
            if (neighbor > original_next) {
                candidates.push_back(neighbor);
            }
        }
        if (candidates.empty()) continue;
        sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());

        for (int candidate : candidates) {
            auto adj_copy = adj;

            adj_copy[current].erase(adj_copy[current].find(candidate));
            adj_copy[candidate].erase(adj_copy[candidate].find(current));

            vector<int> degrees(n + 1, 0);
            for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
                degrees[u] = adj_copy[u].size();
            }

            int odd_count = 0;
            bool valid_degrees = true;
            for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
                if (degrees[u] % 2 != 0) {
                    odd_count++;
                    if (u != candidate && u != original[0]) {
                        valid_degrees = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (odd_count != 2 || !valid_degrees) continue;

            queue<int> q;
            vector<bool> visited(n + 1, false);
            q.push(candidate);
            visited[candidate] = true;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                for (int v : adj_copy[u]) {
                    if (!visited[v]) {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!visited[original[0]]) continue;

            vector<int> path;
            vector<int> stack;
            unordered_map<int, int> ptr;
            for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
                vector<int> tmp(adj_copy[u].begin(), adj_copy[u].end());
                sort(tmp.begin(), tmp.end());
                adj_copy[u] = multiset<int>(tmp.begin(), tmp.end());
                ptr[u] = 0;
            }

            stack.push_back(candidate);
            while (!stack.empty()) {
                int u = stack.back();
                if (!adj_copy[u].empty()) {
                    int v = *adj_copy[u].begin();
                    adj_copy[u].erase(adj_copy[u].begin());
                    adj_copy[v].erase(adj_copy[v].find(u));
                    stack.push_back(v);
                } else {
                    path.push_back(u);
                    stack.pop_back();
                }
            }

            reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
            if (path.size() != m - k) continue;
            if (path.back() != original[0]) continue;

            vector<int> new_seq;
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) new_seq.push_back(original[i]);
            new_seq.push_back(candidate);
            new_seq.insert(new_seq.end(), path.begin(), path.end());

            return new_seq;
        }
    }

    return {};
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<int> original(m + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
        cin >> original[i];
    }

    vector<int> result = find_next_path(n, m, original);

    if (result.empty()) {
        cout << "No solution" << endl;
    } else {
        for (int x : result) {
            cout << x << " ";
        }
        cout << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
int C[51][51];

void precompute_comb() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        C[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD;
    }
}

int main() {
    precompute_comb();
    int n, k, A = 0, B = 0;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> w(n);
    for (int& x : w) {
        cin >> x;
        (x == 50 ? A : B)++;
    }

    if ((A && k < 50) || (B && k < 100)) {
        cout << "-1\n0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int steps[51][51][2];
    long long ways[51][51][2];
    memset(steps, -1, sizeof(steps));
    memset(ways, 0, sizeof(ways));
    queue<tuple<int, int, int>> q;

    steps[A][B][0] = 0;
    ways[A][B][0] = 1;
    q.push({A, B, 0});

    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [a, b, pos] = q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (a == 0 && b == 0 && pos == 1) {
            cout << steps[a][b][pos] << '\n' << ways[a][b][pos] << '\n';
            return 0;
        }

        int curr_steps = steps[a][b][pos];
        long long curr_ways = ways[a][b][pos];

        if (pos == 0) {
            for (int x = 0; x <= a; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y <= b; y++) {
                    if (x + y == 0 || 50*x + 100*y > k) continue;
                    int na = a - x, nb = b - y;
                    if (na < 0 || nb < 0) continue;
                    if (steps[na][nb][1] == -1) {
                        steps[na][nb][1] = curr_steps + 1;
                        ways[na][nb][1] = (curr_ways * C[a][x] % MOD) * C[b][y] % MOD;
                        q.push({na, nb, 1});
                    } else if (steps[na][nb][1] == curr_steps + 1) {
                        ways[na][nb][1] = (ways[na][nb][1] + (curr_ways * C[a][x] % MOD) * C[b][y] % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int avail_a = A - a, avail_b = B - b;
            for (int x = 0; x <= avail_a; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y <= avail_b; y++) {
                    if (x + y == 0 || 50*x + 100*y > k) continue;
                    int na = a + x, nb = b + y;
                    if (na > A || nb > B) continue;
                    if (steps[na][nb][0] == -1) {
                        steps[na][nb][0] = curr_steps + 1;
                        ways[na][nb][0] = (curr_ways * C[avail_a][x] % MOD) * C[avail_b][y] % MOD;
                        q.push({na, nb, 0});
                    } else if (steps[na][nb][0] == curr_steps + 1) {
                        ways[na][nb][0] = (ways[na][nb][0] + (curr_ways * C[avail_a][x] % MOD) * C[avail_b][y] % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << "-1\n0\n";
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int x, y, id;
    Point(int x = 0, int y = 0, int id = 0) : x(x), y(y), id(id) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y;
    }
};

Point p0;

int cross(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
}

int cross(const Point& a, const Point& b, const Point& c) {
    return (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x);
}

bool compare_ccw(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    Point va = Point(a.x - p0.x, a.y - p0.y);
    Point vb = Point(b.x - p0.x, b.y - p0.y);
    int cr = cross(va, vb);
    if (cr != 0) return cr > 0;
    return (va.x * va.x + va.y * va.y) < (vb.x * vb.x + vb.y * vb.y);
}

bool segments_intersect(const Point& a, const Point& b, const Point& c, const Point& d) {
    int o1 = cross(a, b, c);
    int o2 = cross(a, b, d);
    int o3 = cross(c, d, a);
    int o4 = cross(c, d, b);
    if ((o1 > 0 && o2 < 0) || (o1 < 0 && o2 > 0)) {
        if ((o3 > 0 && o4 < 0) || (o3 < 0 && o4 > 0)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        points.emplace_back(x, y, i + 1);
    }
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    int p0_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (points[i].x < points[p0_idx].x || (points[i].x == points[p0_idx].x && points[i].y < points[p0_idx].y)) {
            p0_idx = i;
        }
    }
    p0 = points[p0_idx];

    vector<Point> sorted;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i != p0_idx) {
            sorted.push_back(points[i]);
        }
    }
    sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end(), compare_ccw);

    vector<Point> perm;
    perm.push_back(p0);
    perm.push_back(sorted[0]);

    vector<Point> remaining;
    for (const auto& pt : sorted) {
        if (pt == sorted[0]) continue;
        remaining.push_back(pt);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; ++i) {
        char turn = s[i];
        Point a = perm[perm.size() - 2];
        Point b = perm.back();

        vector<Point> candidates;
        for (const auto& c : remaining) {
            int cr = cross(a, b, c);
            if ((turn == 'L' && cr > 0) || (turn == 'R' && cr < 0)) {
                candidates.push_back(c);
            }
        }

        if (candidates.empty()) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }

        if (turn == 'L') {
            sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [&](const Point& c1, const Point& c2) {
                return cross(a, b, c1) > cross(a, b, c2);
            });
        } else {
            sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [&](const Point& c1, const Point& c2) {
                return cross(a, b, c1) < cross(a, b, c2);
            });
        }

        bool found = false;
        for (const auto& c : candidates) {
            bool intersect = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < perm.size() - 1; ++j) {
                if (j == perm.size() - 2) continue;
                if (segments_intersect(perm[j], perm[j + 1], b, c)) {
                    intersect = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!intersect) {
                perm.push_back(c);
                auto it = find(remaining.begin(), remaining.end(), c);
                remaining.erase(it);
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!found) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    if (!remaining.empty()) {
        perm.push_back(remaining[0]);
    }

    for (const auto& p : perm) {
        cout << p.id << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int64_t min_val;
    int64_t add;
};

vector<Node> tree;

void build(int node, int l, int r, const vector<int64_t>& a) {
    if (l == r) {
        tree[node].min_val = a[l];
        tree[node].add = 0;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    build(2*node, l, mid, a);
    build(2*node+1, mid+1, r, a);
    tree[node].min_val = min(tree[2*node].min_val, tree[2*node+1].min_val);
    tree[node].add = 0;
}

void push(int node, int l, int r) {
    if (tree[node].add != 0 && l != r) {
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        int left = 2*node;
        int right = 2*node +1;

        tree[left].add += tree[node].add;
        tree[left].min_val += tree[node].add;

        tree[right].add += tree[node].add;
        tree[right].min_val += tree[node].add;

        tree[node].add = 0;
    }
}

void update_range(int node, int l, int r, int ul, int ur, int64_t delta) {
    if (ur < l || ul > r) {
        return;
    }
    if (ul <= l && r <= ur) {
        tree[node].min_val += delta;
        tree[node].add += delta;
        return;
    }
    push(node, l, r);
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    update_range(2*node, l, mid, ul, ur, delta);
    update_range(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ul, ur, delta);
    tree[node].min_val = min(tree[2*node].min_val, tree[2*node+1].min_val);
}

int64_t query_range(int node, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (qr < l || ql > r) {
        return LLONG_MAX;
    }
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        return tree[node].min_val;
    }
    push(node, l, r);
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    int64_t left_min = query_range(2*node, l, mid, ql, qr);
    int64_t right_min = query_range(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ql, qr);
    return min(left_min, right_min);
}

vector<pair<int, int>> get_intervals(int lf, int rg, int n) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> res;
    if (lf <= rg) {
        res.emplace_back(lf, rg);
    } else {
        res.emplace_back(lf, n-1);
        res.emplace_back(0, rg);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int64_t> a(n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    tree.resize(4 * n);
    build(1, 0, n-1, a);

    int m;
    cin >> m;
    cin.ignore();

    while (m--) {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        istringstream iss(line);
        int lf, rg, v;
        vector<int> tokens;
        int x;
        while (iss >> x) {
            tokens.push_back(x);
        }
        if (tokens.size() == 3) {
            lf = tokens[0];
            rg = tokens[1];
            v = tokens[2];
            auto intervals = get_intervals(lf, rg, n);
            for (auto& [a, b] : intervals) {
                update_range(1, 0, n-1, a, b, v);
            }
        } else if (tokens.size() == 2) {
            lf = tokens[0];
            rg = tokens[1];
            auto intervals = get_intervals(lf, rg, n);
            int64_t min_val = LLONG_MAX;
            for (auto& [a, b] : intervals) {
                min_val = min(min_val, query_range(1, 0, n-1, a, b));
            }
            cout << min_val << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class BipartiteMatching {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<int> pair_u, pair_v, dist;
    int n, m;

    BipartiteMatching(int n, int m) : n(n), m(m) {
        adj.resize(n);
        pair_u.resize(n, -1);
        pair_v.resize(m, -1);
        dist.resize(n);
    }

    void add_edge(int u, int v) {
        adj[u].push_back(v);
    }

    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
            if (pair_u[u] == -1) {
                dist[u] = 0;
                q.push(u);
            } else {
                dist[u] = -1;
            }
        }
        bool found = false;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (pair_v[v] == -1) {
                    found = true;
                } else if (dist[pair_v[v]] == -1) {
                    dist[pair_v[v]] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push(pair_v[v]);
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (pair_v[v] == -1 || (dist[pair_v[v]] == dist[u] + 1 && dfs(pair_v[v]))) {
                pair_u[u] = v;
                pair_v[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        dist[u] = -1;
        return false;
    }

    int max_matching() {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                if (pair_u[u] == -1) {
                    if (dfs(u)) {
                        result++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<string> grid(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> grid[i];
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> blacks;
    vector<vector<int>> idx(n, vector<int>(m, -1));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            if (grid[i][j] == '#') {
                idx[i][j] = blacks.size();
                blacks.emplace_back(i, j);
            }
        }
    }

    int k = blacks.size();
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> adj(k);
    for (int u = 0; u < k; u++) {
        auto [i, j] = blacks[u];
        if (j + 1 < m && idx[i][j + 1] != -1) {
            int v = idx[i][j + 1];
            adj[u].push_back(v);
        }
        if (i + 1 < n && idx[i + 1][j] != -1) {
            int v = idx[i + 1][j];
            adj[u].push_back(v);
        }
    }

    BipartiteMatching bm(k, k);
    for (int u = 0; u < k; u++) {
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            bm.add_edge(u, v);
        }
    }

    int matching = bm.max_matching();
    cout << k - matching << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <iostream>

class WidgetBase {
public:
    virtual ~WidgetBase() = default;
    virtual pair<int, int> computeSize() const = 0;
    string name;
    WidgetBase(const string& n) : name(n) {}
};

class SimpleWidget : public WidgetBase {
    int w, h;
public:
    SimpleWidget(const string& n, int w, int h) : WidgetBase(n), w(w), h(h) {}
    pair<int, int> computeSize() const override {
        return {w, h};
    }
};

class HBoxWidget : public WidgetBase {
public:
    vector<WidgetBase*> children;
    int border = 0;
    int spacing = 0;

    HBoxWidget(const string& n) : WidgetBase(n) {}

    pair<int, int> computeSize() const override {
        if (children.empty()) return {0, 0};
        int total_width = 0, max_height = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < children.size(); ++i) {
            auto [cw, ch] = children[i]->computeSize();
            total_width += cw + (i ? spacing : 0);
            max_height = max(max_height, ch);
        }
        return {total_width + 2 * border, max_height + 2 * border};
    }
};

class VBoxWidget : public WidgetBase {
public:
    vector<WidgetBase*> children;
    int border = 0;
    int spacing = 0;

    VBoxWidget(const string& n) : WidgetBase(n) {}

    pair<int, int> computeSize() const override {
        if (children.empty()) return {0, 0};
        int total_height = 0, max_width = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < children.size(); ++i) {
            auto [cw, ch] = children[i]->computeSize();
            total_height += ch + (i ? spacing : 0);
            max_width = max(max_width, cw);
        }
        return {max_width + 2 * border, total_height + 2 * border};
    }
};

int main() {
    map<string, WidgetBase*> widgets;
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);

        if (line.substr(0, 6) == "Widget") {
            size_t p = line.find('(');
            string name = line.substr(7, p - 7);
            string args = line.substr(p + 1, line.size() - p - 2);
            size_t c = args.find(',');
            int x = stoi(args.substr(0, c)), y = stoi(args.substr(c + 1));
            widgets[name] = new SimpleWidget(name, x, y);
        } else if (line.substr(0, 4) == "HBox") {
            widgets[line.substr(5)] = new HBoxWidget(line.substr(5));
        } else if (line.substr(0, 4) == "VBox") {
            widgets[line.substr(5)] = new VBoxWidget(line.substr(5));
        } else {
            size_t dot = line.find('.');
            string name = line.substr(0, dot);
            string rest = line.substr(dot + 1);
            size_t paren = rest.find('(');
            string method = rest.substr(0, paren);
            string arg = rest.substr(paren + 1, rest.size() - paren - 2);

            WidgetBase* obj = widgets[name];
            if (method == "pack") {
                WidgetBase* child = widgets[arg];
                if (auto h = dynamic_cast<HBoxWidget*>(obj)) h->children.push_back(child);
                else if (auto v = dynamic_cast<VBoxWidget*>(obj)) v->children.push_back(child);
            } else if (method == "set_border") {
                int val = stoi(arg);
                if (auto h = dynamic_cast<HBoxWidget*>(obj)) h->border = val;
                else if (auto v = dynamic_cast<VBoxWidget*>(obj)) v->border = val;
            } else if (method == "set_spacing") {
                int val = stoi(arg);
                if (auto h = dynamic_cast<HBoxWidget*>(obj)) h->spacing = val;
                else if (auto v = dynamic_cast<VBoxWidget*>(obj)) v->spacing = val;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<string> names;
    for (auto& [k, v] : widgets) names.push_back(k);
    sort(names.begin(), names.end());

    for (auto& name : names) {
        auto [w, h] = widgets[name]->computeSize();
        cout << name << " " << w << " " << h << "\n";
    }

    for (auto& [k, v] : widgets) delete v;
    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Query {
    int l, r, t, idx;
};

struct Update {
    int p, old_val, new_val;
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, q;
    cin >> n >> q;
    vector<int> original_a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> original_a[i];
    }
    vector<Update> updates;
    vector<Query> queries;
    vector<int> answer(q, -1);
    int time = 0;
    vector<int> current_a = original_a;

    for (int i = 0; i < q; ++i) {
        int type;
        cin >> type;
        if (type == 1) {
            int l, r;
            cin >> l >> r;
            queries.push_back({l-1, r-1, time, (int)queries.size()});
        } else {
            int p, x;
            cin >> p >> x;
            --p;
            int old_val = current_a[p];
            updates.push_back({p, old_val, x});
            current_a[p] = x;
            ++time;
        }
    }

    current_a = original_a;

    int block_size = pow(n, 2.0/3.0);
    sort(queries.begin(), queries.end(), [&](const Query& a, const Query& b) {
        if (a.l / block_size != b.l / block_size)
            return a.l / block_size < b.l / block_size;
        if (a.r / block_size != b.r / block_size)
            return (a.l / block_size) % 2 ? a.r > b.r : a.r < b.r;
        return a.t < b.t;
    });

    int current_l = 0, current_r = -1, current_time = 0;
    unordered_map<int, int> cnt;
    unordered_map<int, int> freq_cnt;

    auto add = [&](int val) {
        if (cnt[val] > 0) {
            freq_cnt[cnt[val]]--;
            if (freq_cnt[cnt[val]] == 0)
                freq_cnt.erase(cnt[val]);
        }
        cnt[val]++;
        freq_cnt[cnt[val]]++;
    };

    auto remove = [&](int val) {
        freq_cnt[cnt[val]]--;
        if (freq_cnt[cnt[val]] == 0)
            freq_cnt.erase(cnt[val]);
        cnt[val]--;
        if (cnt[val] > 0) {
            freq_cnt[cnt[val]]++;
        } else {
            cnt.erase(val);
        }
    };

    auto apply_update = [&](int p, int old_val, int new_val) {
        if (current_l <= p && p <= current_r) {
            remove(old_val);
            add(new_val);
        }
        current_a[p] = new_val;
    };

    auto undo_update = [&](int p, int old_val, int new_val) {
        if (current_l <= p && p <= current_r) {
            remove(new_val);
            add(old_val);
        }
        current_a[p] = old_val;
    };

    for (const auto& query : queries) {
        int l = query.l;
        int r = query.r;
        int t = query.t;
        int idx = query.idx;

        while (current_time < t) {
            Update& upd = updates[current_time];
            apply_update(upd.p, upd.old_val, upd.new_val);
            current_time++;
        }
        while (current_time > t) {
            current_time--;
            Update& upd = updates[current_time];
            undo_update(upd.p, upd.new_val, upd.old_val);
        }

        while (current_l > l) {
            current_l--;
            add(current_a[current_l]);
        }
        while (current_r < r) {
            current_r++;
            add(current_a[current_r]);
        }
        while (current_l < l) {
            remove(current_a[current_l]);
            current_l++;
        }
        while (current_r > r) {
            remove(current_a[current_r]);
            current_r--;
        }

        int mex = 1;
        while (freq_cnt.find(mex) != freq_cnt.end()) {
            mex++;
        }
        answer[idx] = mex;
    }

    for (int ans : answer) {
        if (ans != -1) {
            cout << ans << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-
