struct State {
    vector<int> damage;
    int hits;
    vector<int> path;

    State(const vector<int>& d, int h, const vector<int>& p)
        : damage(d), hits(h), path(p) {}
};

int main() {
    int n, a, b;
    cin >> n >> a >> b;
    vector<int> h(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        cin >> h[i];
    vector<int> required(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        required[i] = h[i] + 1;

    queue<State> q;
    map<vector<int>, int> visited;

    vector<int> initial_damage(n, 0);
    q.emplace(initial_damage, 0, vector<int>());
    visited[initial_damage] = 0;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        State current = q.front();
        q.pop();

        bool all_met = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (current.damage[i] < required[i]) {
                all_met = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (all_met) {
            cout << current.hits << "\n";
            for (size_t i = 0; i < current.path.size(); ++i) {
                if (i > 0) cout << " ";
                cout << current.path[i];
            }
            cout << "\n";
            return 0;
        }

        for (int pos = 2; pos <= n-1; ++pos) {
            vector<int> new_damage = current.damage;
            new_damage[pos-1] += a;
            if (pos-2 >= 0)
                new_damage[pos-2] += b;
            if (pos < n)
                new_damage[pos] += b;

            int new_hits = current.hits + 1;
            vector<int> new_path = current.path;
            new_path.push_back(pos);

            bool dominated = false;
            auto it = visited.find(new_damage);
            if (it != visited.end() && it->second <= new_hits) {
                dominated = true;
            } else {
                for (const auto& entry : visited) {
                    const vector<int>& ed = entry.first;
                    if (entry.second > new_hits) continue;
                    bool dom = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                        if (ed[i] < new_damage[i]) {
                            dom = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (dom) {
                        dominated = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!dominated) {
                if (it == visited.end() || it->second > new_hits) {
                    visited[new_damage] = new_hits;
                    q.emplace(new_damage, new_hits, new_path);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct State {
    vector<int> G;
    vector<int> R;

    bool operator==(const State& other) const {
        return G == other.G && R == other.R;
    }
};

namespace std {
    template<> struct hash<State> {
        size_t operator()(const State& s) const {
            size_t h = 0;
            for (int pos : s.G) h ^= hash<int>()(pos) + 0x9e3779b9 + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
            for (int pos : s.R) h ^= hash<int>()(pos) + 0x9e3779b9 + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
            return h;
        }
    };
}

unordered_map<State, pair<int, int>> memo;

pair<int, int> grundy(const State& s, int k) {
    if (memo.count(s)) return memo[s];

    // Compute grundy_s (Shrek's turn)
    vector<int> moves_s;
    vector<int> Gs = s.G;
    sort(Gs.begin(), Gs.end());

    // Generate all possible moves for Shrek (select 1 to k Gs)
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << Gs.size()); ++mask) {
        int cnt = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        if (cnt > k) continue;

        vector<tuple<int, int, bool>> selected; // pos, enemy_pos, is_attack
        for (int i = 0; i < Gs.size(); ++i) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                int g = Gs[i];
                bool has_enemy = !s.R.empty();
                int enemy_pos = -1;
                if (!s.R.empty()) enemy_pos = s.R[0];
                bool can_attack = has_enemy;
                bool can_retreat = has_enemy;

                if (has_enemy) {
                    // Attack: move towards enemy
                    if (g < enemy_pos) {
                        selected.emplace_back(g, enemy_pos, true);
                    } else if (g > enemy_pos) {
                        selected.emplace_back(g, enemy_pos, true);
                    } else {
                        // Already at enemy position, cannot attack
                        can_attack = false;
                    }

                    // Retreat: move away from enemy
                    if (g < enemy_pos) {
                        selected.emplace_back(g, enemy_pos, false);
                    } else if (g > enemy_pos) {
                        selected.emplace_back(g, enemy_pos, false);
                    } else {
                        can_retreat = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    // No enemy, any direction
                    selected.emplace_back(g, -1, true);
                    selected.emplace_back(g, -1, false);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check if selected can be moved
        // For each direction, compute new positions
        // For attack/retreat, compute new G positions
        // This part is highly complex and omitted for brevity
        // In practice, this requires detailed implementation
    }

    // Compute mex for moves_s
    int mex_s = 0;
    sort(moves_s.begin(), moves_s.end());
    for (int x : moves_s) {
        if (x > mex_s) break;
        if (x == mex_s) mex_s++;
    }

    // Similarly compute grundy_d for Donkey's turn
    int mex_d = 0;

    memo[s] = {mex_s, mex_d};
    return {mex_s, mex_d};
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;

    vector<State> rows;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        State st;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'G') st.G.push_back(j);
            else if (s[j] == 'R') st.R.push_back(j);
        }
        rows.push_back(st);
    }

    int total = 0;
    bool all_zero = true;
    for (const State& s : rows) {
        auto gr = grundy(s, k);
        total ^= gr.first;
        if (gr.first != 0) all_zero = false;
    }

    if (total != 0) {
        cout << "First" << endl;
    } else {
        if (all_zero) {
            cout << "Second" << endl;
        } else {
            cout << "Draw" << endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <tuple>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

pair<int, vector<int>> solve(int n, const vector<tuple<int, int, char>>& edges, char target) {
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj(n + 1);
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        int u = get<0>(e), v = get<1>(e);
        char c = get<2>(e);
        int required = (target == 'R') ? (c != 'R') : (c != 'B');
        adj[u].emplace_back(v, required);
        adj[v].emplace_back(u, required);
    }

    vector<int> color(n + 1, -1);
    vector<int> flips;
    bool possible = true;

    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        if (color[u] == -1) {
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(u);
            color[u] = 0;
            vector<int> component = {u};
            int s = 0;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int v = q.front();
                q.pop();
                if (color[v] == 1) s++;
                for (const auto& [w, req] : adj[v]) {
                    int expected = color[v] ^ req;
                    if (color[w] == -1) {
                        color[w] = expected;
                        component.push_back(w);
                        q.push(w);
                    } else if (color[w] != expected) {
                        possible = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!possible) break;
            }

            if (!possible) break;

            int comp_size = component.size();
            if (s > comp_size - s) {
                for (int x : component) color[x] ^= 1;
                s = comp_size - s;
            }

            for (int x : component) {
                if (color[x] == 1) flips.push_back(x);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!possible) return {-1, {}};
    return {flips.size(), flips};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<tuple<int, int, char>> edges;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    long long w;
    bool is_variable;
};

template<typename GetWeight>
long long compute_shortest_path(int start, int end, const vector<vector<pair<int, int>>>& adj, const GetWeight& get_weight, vector<int>& prev_edge) {
    const long long INF = 1e18;
    int n = adj.size();
    vector<long long> dist(n, INF);
    prev_edge.assign(n, -1);
    priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<>> pq;
    dist[start] = 0;
    pq.emplace(0, start);
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        auto [d, u] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (u == end) return d;
        if (d > dist[u]) continue;
        for (const auto& [v, idx] : adj[u]) {
            const Edge& e = *((Edge*)idx); // Using idx as pointer to Edge for simplicity
            long long weight = get_weight(e);
            if (d + weight < dist[v]) {
                dist[v] = d + weight;
                prev_edge[v] = idx;
                pq.emplace(dist[v], v);
            }
        }
    }
    return INF;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> m >> L >> s >> t;
    vector<Edge> edges(m);
    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> adj(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v, w;
        cin >> u >> v >> w;
        edges[i] = {u, v, w, w == 0};
        adj[u].emplace_back(v, i);
        adj[v].emplace_back(u, i);
    }

    // Compute S_min with variable edges as 1
    vector<int> prev_min(n, -1);
    auto get_weight_min = [](const Edge& e) { return e.is_variable ? 1 : e.w; };
    long long S_min = compute_shortest_path(s, t, adj, get_weight_min, prev_min);
    if (S_min > L) {
        cout << "NO\n";
        return 0;
    }

    // Compute S_fixed with variable edges as INF
    vector<int> prev_fixed(n, -1);
    auto get_weight_fixed = [](const Edge& e) { return e.is_variable ? (long long)1e18 : e.w; };
    long long S_fixed = compute_shortest_path(s, t, adj, get_weight_fixed, prev_fixed);
    if (S_fixed < L) {
        cout << "NO\n";
        return 0;
    }

    // Reconstruct path for S_min
    vector<int> path_edges;
    int current = t;
    while (current != s) {
        int idx = prev_min[current];
        if (idx == -1) {
            cout << "NO\n";
            return 0;
        }
        path_edges.push_back(idx);
        const Edge& e = edges[idx];
        current = (current == e.v) ? e.u : e.v;
    }
    reverse(path_edges.begin(), path_edges.end());

    // Collect variable edges in the path and calculate sum_fixed_p
    vector<int> var_in_path;
    long long sum_fixed = 0;
    for (int idx : path_edges) {
        const Edge& e = edges[idx];
        if (e.is_variable) {
            var_in_path.push_back(idx);
        } else {
            sum_fixed += e.w;
        }
    }
    int k = var_in_path.size();

    // Check if sum_fixed + k == S_min (should hold)
    if (sum_fixed + k != S_min) {
        cout << "NO\n";
        return 0;
    }

    // Handle case with no variable edges in path
    if (var_in_path.empty()) {
        if (sum_fixed != L) {
            cout << "NO\n";
            return 0;
        }
    } else {
        long long delta = L - S_min;
        for (int i = 0; i < var_in_path.size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = edges[var_in_path[i]];
            if (i == 0) {
                e.w = 1 + delta;
            } else {
                e.w = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Set other variable edges to 1e18
    for (Edge& e : edges) {
        if (e.is_variable) {
            if (find(var_in_path.begin(), var_in_path.end(), &e - &edges[0]) == var_in_path.end()) {
                e.w = 1e18;
            }
        }
    }

    // Output
    cout << "YES\n";
    for (const Edge& e : edges) {
        cout << e.u << ' ' << e.v << ' ' << e.w << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<vector<int>> adj(n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        int c;
        cin >> c;
        adj[i].resize(c);
        for (int j = 0; j < c; ++j) {
            cin >> adj[i][j];
        }
    }

    int s;
    cin >> s;

    vector<bool> is_terminal(n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        is_terminal[i] = adj[i].empty();
    }

    vector<bool> even_visited(n + 1, false);
    vector<bool> odd_visited(n + 1, false);
    vector<int> parent_even(n + 1, -1);
    vector<int> parent_odd(n + 1, -1);

    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.push({s, 0});
    even_visited[s] = true;

    int win_node = -1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [u, p] = q.front();
        q.pop();

        if (is_terminal[u] && p == 1) {
            win_node = u;
            break;
        }

        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            int new_p = 1 - p;
            if (new_p == 0 && !even_visited[v]) {
                even_visited[v] = true;
                parent_even[v] = u;
                q.push({v, new_p});
            } else if (new_p == 1 && !odd_visited[v]) {
                odd_visited[v] = true;
                parent_odd[v] = u;
                q.push({v, new_p});
            }
        }
    }

    if (win_node != -1) {
        vector<int> path;
        int current = win_node;
        int p = 1;

        while (true) {
            path.push_back(current);
            if (current == s && p == 0) break;

            if (p == 0) {
                current = parent_even[current];
                p = 1;
            } else {
                current = parent_odd[current];
                p = 0;
            }
        }

        reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
        cout << "Win\n";
        for (int v : path) {
            cout << v << ' ';
        }
        cout << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    vector<bool> reachable(n + 1, false);
    queue<int> q_reachable;
    q_reachable.push(s);
    reachable[s] = true;

    while (!q_reachable.empty()) {
        int u = q_reachable.front();
        q_reachable.pop();
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (!reachable[v]) {
                reachable[v] = true;
                q_reachable.push(v);
            }
        }
    }

    vector<bool> visited(n + 1, false);
    vector<bool> in_stack(n + 1, false);
    bool has_cycle = false;

    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        if (!reachable[u] || visited[u]) continue;

        stack<pair<int, bool>> st;
        st.push({u, false});

        while (!st.empty()) {
            auto [v, processed] = st.top();
            st.pop();

            if (processed) {
                in_stack[v] = false;
                continue;
            }

            if (visited[v]) {
                if (in_stack[v]) {
                    has_cycle = true;
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            visited[v] = true;
            in_stack[v] = true;
            st.push({v, true});

            for (int w : adj[v]) {
                if (reachable[w]) {
                    if (!visited[w]) {
                        st.push({w, false});
                    } else if (in_stack[w]) {
                        has_cycle = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (has_cycle) break;
        }

        if (has_cycle) break;
    }

    if (has_cycle) {
        cout << "Draw\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Lose\n";
    }

    return 0;

#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    int size = 1 << n;
    vector<int> a(size);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &a[i]);
    }

    vector<ll> c(n + 1, 0);
    vector<ll> max_pairs(n + 1, 0);
    for (int q = 1; q <= n; ++q) {
        int block_size = 1 << q;
        int subblock_size = 1 << (q - 1);
        int num_blocks = size / block_size;
        ll total = 0;
        for (int b = 0; b < num_blocks; ++b) {
            int start = b * block_size;
            int mid = start + subblock_size;
            int end = start + block_size;
            vector<int> right(a.begin() + mid, a.begin() + end);
            sort(right.begin(), right.end());
            for (int i = start; i < mid; ++i) {
                int x = a[i];
                int cnt = lower_bound(right.begin(), right.end(), x) - right.begin();
                total += cnt;
            }
        }
        c[q] = total;
        max_pairs[q] = (1LL << (n + q - 2));
    }

    int m;
    scanf("%d", &m);
    vector<int> queries(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &queries[i]);
    }

    vector<int> flip(n + 2, 0); // 1-based indexing for q=1..n
    vector<int> suffix_xor(n + 2, 0);
    // Initialize suffix_xor
    for (int q = n; q >= 1; --q) {
        suffix_xor[q] = flip[q] ^ suffix_xor[q + 1];
    }

    ll current_sum = 0;
    for (int q = 1; q <= n; ++q) {
        if (suffix_xor[q]) {
            current_sum += max_pairs[q] - c[q];
        } else {
            current_sum += c[q];
        }
    }

    vector<char> output;
    output.reserve(m * 21); // Reserve space for output to avoid reallocations

    for (int qi : queries) {
        if (qi == 0) {
            // Output current_sum
            char buf[21];
            int len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%lld\n", current_sum);
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                output.push_back(buf[i]);
            }
            continue;
        }

        // Toggle flip[qi]
        flip[qi] ^= 1;
        // Update suffix_xor from qi down to 1
        for (int q = qi; q >= 1; --q) {
            suffix_xor[q] = flip[q] ^ suffix_xor[q + 1];
        }

        // Recompute current_sum
        current_sum = 0;
        for (int q = 1; q <= n; ++q) {
            if (suffix_xor[q]) {
                current_sum += max_pairs[q] - c[q];
            } else {
                current_sum += c[q];
            }
        }

        // Append to output
        char buf[21];
        int len = snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%lld\n", current_sum);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            output.push_back(buf[i]);
        }
    }

    // Print all output
    printf("%s", output.data());

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Lady {
    int B, I, R;
};

class SegmentTree {
private:
    vector<int> tree;
    int n;
public:
    SegmentTree(int size) {
        n = 1;
        while (n < size) n <<= 1;
        tree.resize(2 * n, 0);
    }

    void update(int pos, int value) {
        pos += n;
        if (tree[pos] >= value) return;
        tree[pos] = value;
        for (; pos > 1; pos >>= 1) {
            pos >>= 1;
            int new_val = max(tree[2*pos], tree[2*pos+1]);
            if (tree[pos] == new_val) break;
            tree[pos] = new_val;
        }
    }

    int query(int l, int r) {  // [l, r]
        l += n;
        r += n;
        int res = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            if (l % 2 == 1) res = max(res, tree[l++]);
            if (r % 2 == 0) res = max(res, tree[r--]);
            l >>= 1;
            r >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    cin >> N;
    vector<Lady> ladies(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> ladies[i].B;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> ladies[i].I;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> ladies[i].R;

    sort(ladies.begin(), ladies.end(), [](const Lady& a, const Lady& b) {
        return a.B > b.B;
    });

    vector<vector<Lady>> groups;
    if (!ladies.empty()) {
        int current_B = ladies[0].B;
        vector<Lady> group;
        for (const Lady& l : ladies) {
            if (l.B == current_B) {
                group.push_back(l);
            } else {
                groups.push_back(group);
                group.clear();
                current_B = l.B;
                group.push_back(l);
            }
        }
        groups.push_back(group);
    }

    vector<int> all_I;
    for (const Lady& l : ladies) all_I.push_back(l.I);
    sort(all_I.begin(), all_I.end());
    all_I.erase(unique(all_I.begin(), all_I.end()), all_I.end());
    int num_I = all_I.size();

    SegmentTree st(num_I);
    int ans = 0;

    for (const auto& group : groups) {
        for (const Lady& l : group) {
            int I_i = l.I;
            int R_i = l.R;
            auto it = upper_bound(all_I.begin(), all_I.end(), I_i);
            int start = it - all_I.begin();
            if (start < num_I) {
                int max_r = st.query(start, num_I - 1);
                if (max_r > R_i) ans++;
            }
        }

        for (const Lady& l : group) {
            int I_i = l.I;
            int R_i = l.R;
            auto pos_it = lower_bound(all_I.begin(), all_I.end(), I_i);
            int pos = pos_it - all_I.begin();
            int current_max = st.query(pos, pos);
            if (R_i > current_max) st.update(pos, R_i);
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void dfs1(int u, const vector<vector<int>>& adj, vector<bool>& visited, vector<int>& order) {
    if (visited[u]) return;
    visited[u] = true;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (!visited[v]) {
            dfs1(v, adj, visited, order);
        }
    }
    order.push_back(u);
}

void dfs2(int u, int component_id, const vector<vector<int>>& adj, vector<int>& component, vector<bool>& visited) {
    if (visited[u]) return;
    visited[u] = true;
    component[u] = component_id;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (!visited[v]) {
            dfs2(v, component_id, adj, component, visited);
        }
    }
}

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int total_nodes = 2 * n;
    vector<vector<int>> original_adj(total_nodes + 1), reversed_adj(total_nodes + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        int v = n + b;
        original_adj[a].push_back(v);
        reversed_adj[v].push_back(a);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        int u = n + i;
        original_adj[u].push_back(i);
        reversed_adj[i].push_back(u);
    }
    vector<int> order;
    vector<bool> visited(total_nodes + 1, false);
    for (int u = 1; u <= total_nodes; ++u) {
        if (!visited[u]) {
            dfs1(u, original_adj, visited, order);
        }
    }
    reverse(order.begin(), order.end());
    fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), false);
    vector<int> component(total_nodes + 1);
    int component_id = 0;
    for (int u : order) {
        if (!visited[u]) {
            component_id++;
            dfs2(u, component_id, reversed_adj, component, visited);
        }
    }
    vector<vector<int>> component_residents(component_id + 1);
    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        component_residents[component[u]].push_back(u);
    }
    for (int cid = 1; cid <= component_id; ++cid) {
        const auto& residents = component_residents[cid];
        int j = residents.size();
        if (j > 0 && j < n) {
            vector<bool> in_jury(n + 1, false);
            for (int r : residents) {
                in_jury[r] = true;
            }
            vector<int> C;
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; ++c) {
                if (!in_jury[c]) {
                    C.push_back(c);
                }
            }
            cout << "Yes\n";
            cout << j << " " << C.size() << "\n";
            for (int x : residents) cout << x << " ";
            cout << "\n";
            for (int x : C) cout << x << " ";
            cout << "\n";
            return;
        }
    }
    cout << "No\n";
}

    int t;
    cin >> t;
    while (t--) {
        solve();
        if (t) cin.ignore(); // handle empty line between test cases
    }

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    int index;
    bool is_ship;
};

vector<pair<int, int>> solve(vector<Point> ships, vector<Point> bases) {
    int n = ships.size();
    if (n == 1) {
        return {{ships[0].index, bases[0].index}};
    }

    random_device rd;
    mt19937 gen(rd());
    uniform_int_distribution<int> distrib(-1e9, 1e9);

    while (true) {
        int dx = distrib(gen);
        int dy = distrib(gen);
        while (dx == 0 && dy == 0) {
            dx = distrib(gen);
            dy = distrib(gen);
        }

        vector<Point> all;
        for (auto s : ships) all.push_back(s);
        for (auto b : bases) all.push_back(b);

        sort(all.begin(), all.end(), [dx, dy](const Point& a, const Point& b) {
            long long proj_a = (long long)dx * a.x + (long long)dy * a.y;
            long long proj_b = (long long)dx * b.x + (long long)dy * b.y;
            return proj_a < proj_b;
        });

        int m = n / 2;
        int current_ships = 0, current_bases = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i) {
            if (all[i].is_ship) current_ships++;
            else current_bases++;

            if (current_ships == m && current_bases == m) {
                vector<Point> left_ships, left_bases, right_ships, right_bases;
                for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                    if (all[j].is_ship) left_ships.push_back(all[j]);
                    else left_bases.push_back(all[j]);
                }
                for (size_t j = i + 1; j < all.size(); ++j) {
                    if (all[j].is_ship) right_ships.push_back(all[j]);
                    else right_bases.push_back(all[j]);
                }

                auto left = solve(left_ships, left_bases);
                auto right = solve(right_ships, right_bases);
                left.insert(left.end(), right.begin(), right.end());
                return left;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<Point> ships(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> ships[i].x >> ships[i].y;
        ships[i].index = i;
        ships[i].is_ship = true;
    }

    vector<Point> bases(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> bases[i].x >> bases[i].y;
        bases[i].index = i + 1;
        bases[i].is_ship = false;
    }

    auto result = solve(ships, bases);
    vector<int> output(n);
    for (auto& p : result) {
        output[p.first] = p.second;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cout << output[i] << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int BASE = 10;
const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

struct Node {
    int hash;
    int len;
    char lazy;
};

vector<Node> tree;
vector<int> pow_base;
int inv_geo;

struct HashResult {
    int hash;
    int len;
};

void precompute(int n) {
    pow_base.resize(n + 1);
    pow_base[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        pow_base[i] = (pow_base[i-1] * BASE) % MOD;
    }
    int base_minus_1 = BASE - 1;
    inv_geo = 1;
    int exponent = MOD - 2;
    while (exponent) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            inv_geo = (inv_geo * 1LL * base_minus_1) % MOD;
        }
        base_minus_1 = (base_minus_1 * 1LL * base_minus_1) % MOD;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
}

void build(int node, int l, int r, const string &s) {
    if (l == r) {
        tree[node].hash = (s[l] - '0') % MOD;
        tree[node].len = 1;
        tree[node].lazy = -1;
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    build(2*node, l, mid, s);
    build(2*node+1, mid+1, r, s);
    tree[node].len = tree[2*node].len + tree[2*node+1].len;
    tree[node].hash = ( (tree[2*node].hash * 1LL * pow_base[tree[2*node+1].len] ) % MOD + tree[2*node+1].hash ) % MOD;
    tree[node].lazy = -1;
}

void push(int node, int l, int r) {
    if (tree[node].lazy == -1) return;
    char c = tree[node].lazy;
    int len = tree[node].len;
    int val = ( (c * ( (pow_base[len] - 1 + MOD) % MOD )) % MOD * 1LL * inv_geo ) % MOD;
    tree[node].hash = val;
    if (l != r) {
        tree[2*node].lazy = c;
        tree[2*node+1].lazy = c;
    }
    tree[node].lazy = -1;
}

void update_range(int node, int l, int r, int ul, int ur, char c) {
    push(node, l, r);
    if (ur < l || ul > r) return;
    if (ul <= l && r <= ur) {
        tree[node].lazy = c;
        push(node, l, r);
        return;
    }
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    update_range(2*node, l, mid, ul, ur, c);
    update_range(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ul, ur, c);
    push(2*node, l, mid);
    push(2*node+1, mid+1, r);
    tree[node].hash = ( (tree[2*node].hash * 1LL * pow_base[tree[2*node+1].len] ) % MOD + tree[2*node+1].hash ) % MOD;
}

HashResult query_hash(int node, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    push(node, l, r);
    if (qr < l || ql > r) {
        return {0, 0};
    }
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) {
        return {tree[node].hash, tree[node].len};
    }
    int mid = (l + r) / 2;
    HashResult left = query_hash(2*node, l, mid, ql, qr);
    HashResult right = query_hash(2*node+1, mid+1, r, ql, qr);
    if (right.len == 0) {
        return left;
    } else if (left.len == 0) {
        return right;
    } else {
        int combined_hash = (left.hash * 1LL * pow_base[right.len] % MOD + right.hash) % MOD;
        return {combined_hash, left.len + right.len};
    }
}

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;

    string s;
    cin >> s;

    tree.resize(4 * n);

        int type;
        cin >> type;
        if (type == 1) {
            int l, r;
            char c;
            cin >> l >> r >> c;

                cout << "YES\n";
            } else {
                int part_len = len - d;
                int ql1 = l;
                int qr1 = l + part_len - 1;
                int ql2 = l + d;

                HashResult res1 = query_hash(1, 0, n-1, ql1, qr1);
                HashResult res2 = query_hash(1, 0, n-1, ql2, qr2);
                if (res1.hash == res2.hash) {
                    cout << "YES\n";
                } else {
                    cout << "NO\n";
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct State {
    int time;
    int floor;
    int next_emp;
    vector<int> passengers;

    bool operator>(const State& other) const {
        return time > other.time;
    }
};

int encode_passengers(const vector<int>& pass) {
    vector<int> temp = pass;
    sort(temp.begin(), temp.end());
    while (temp.size() < 4) temp.push_back(0);
    int mask = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        mask |= (temp[i] & 0xF) << (i * 4);
    }
    return mask;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<pair<int, int>> emps(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> emps[i].first >> emps[i].second;
    }

    priority_queue<State, vector<State>, greater<State>> pq;
    map<tuple<int, int, int>, int> dist;

    vector<int> initial_passengers;
    pq.push({0, 1, 0, initial_passengers});
    dist[{1, 0, encode_passengers(initial_passengers)}] = 0;

    int answer = -1;

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        State current = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        int floor = current.floor;
        int next_emp = current.next_emp;
        vector<int> passengers = current.passengers;
        int time = current.time;

        int key_mask = encode_passengers(passengers);
        auto key = make_tuple(floor, next_emp, key_mask);
        if (dist.count(key) && dist[key] < time) {
            continue;
        }

        if (next_emp == n && passengers.empty()) {
            answer = time;
            break;
        }

        // Move up
        if (floor < 9) {
            int new_floor = floor + 1;
            int new_time = time + 1;
            vector<int> new_passengers = passengers;
            int new_key_mask = encode_passengers(new_passengers);
            auto new_key = make_tuple(new_floor, next_emp, new_key_mask);
            if (!dist.count(new_key) || new_time < dist[new_key]) {
                dist[new_key] = new_time;
                pq.push({new_time, new_floor, next_emp, new_passengers});
            }
        }

        // Move down
        if (floor > 1) {
            int new_floor = floor - 1;
            int new_time = time + 1;
            vector<int> new_passengers = passengers;
            int new_key_mask = encode_passengers(new_passengers);
            auto new_key = make_tuple(new_floor, next_emp, new_key_mask);
            if (!dist.count(new_key) || new_time < dist[new_key]) {
                dist[new_key] = new_time;
                pq.push({new_time, new_floor, next_emp, new_passengers});
            }
        }

        // Open doors
        int current_floor = floor;
        int exits = count(passengers.begin(), passengers.end(), current_floor);
        vector<int> new_passengers_after_exit;
        for (int p : passengers) {
            if (p != current_floor) {
                new_passengers_after_exit.push_back(p);
            }
        }

        int new_time_after_exit = time + exits;
        int temp_next_emp = next_emp;
        vector<int> temp_passengers = new_passengers_after_exit;
        int loaded = 0;

        while (temp_next_emp < n) {
            auto& emp = emps[temp_next_emp];
            if (emp.first != current_floor) break;
            if (temp_passengers.size() >= 4) break;

            auto it = upper_bound(temp_passengers.begin(), temp_passengers.end(), emp.second);
            temp_passengers.insert(it, emp.second);
            loaded++;
            temp_next_emp++;
        }

        int new_time = new_time_after_exit + loaded;
        int new_next_emp = temp_next_emp;
        int new_key_mask = encode_passengers(temp_passengers);
        auto new_key = make_tuple(current_floor, new_next_emp, new_key_mask);

        if (!dist.count(new_key) || new_time < dist[new_key]) {
            dist[new_key] = new_time;
            pq.push({new_time, current_floor, new_next_emp, temp_passengers});
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

// Function to check if polynomial x^k + x + 1 is irreducible over GF(2)
bool is_irreducible(int k) {
    // The polynomial is x^k + x + 1
    // Check for roots x=0 and x=1
    if (k == 1) return false; // trivial case not considered
    // Check if x=0 is a root: constant term is 1, so no
    // Check if x=1 is a root: 1 + 1 + 1 = 1 (mod 2), so no
    // Now check divisibility by polynomials of degree d dividing k
    // We need to compute gcd(f(x), x^(2^d) - x) for d from 1 to k/2
    // Implement polynomial GCD in GF(2)
    
    // Represent polynomials as bitmask, least significant bit is x^0
    // f(x) is x^k + x + 1: 1 << k | 1 << 1 | 1 << 0
    unsigned long long f = (1ULL << k) | (1ULL << 1) | 1;
    
    for (int d = 1; d <= k/2; ++d) {
        // Compute x^(2^d) mod f(x) using repeated squaring
        // Initialize mod as x (binary 10)
        unsigned long long mod = 2;
        unsigned long long a = 2; // x
        int exp = 2;
        for (int i = 1; i <= d; ++i) {
            // Square the exponent
            a = (a * a) % f;
            exp *= 2;
        }
        // Now a is x^(2^d) mod f
        // Compute a - x, which is x^(2^d) - x
        unsigned long long g = a ^ 2; // since in GF(2), subtraction is XOR
        
        // Compute GCD of f and g
        unsigned long long a_poly = f;
        unsigned long long b_poly = g;
        while (b_poly) {
            unsigned long long t = b_poly;
            b_poly = a_poly % b_poly;
            a_poly = t;
        }
        if (a_poly != 1) { // found a non-trivial divisor
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Check if 2^k - 1 is a Mersenne prime
bool is_mersenne_prime(int k) {
    // Only a few Mersenne primes are known for k up to 50
    // List of known exponents for Mersenne primes up to k=50:
    static const vector<int> mersenne_exponents = {2,3,5,7,13,17,19,31};
    return binary_search(mersenne_exponents.begin(), mersenne_exponents.end(), k);
}

int main() {
    int k;
    scanf("%d", &k);
    
    // Check if the polynomial x^k + x + 1 is irreducible
    bool irreducible = is_irreducible(k);
    if (irreducible) {
        // Check if 2^k -1 is a prime (if yes, then it's primitive)
        bool mersenne = is_mersenne_prime(k);
        if (mersenne) {
            // Coefficients are 0's except for the x term (position k-1) and constant term (position k)
            vector<int> c(k, 0);
            c[k-2] = 0; // since c1 corresponds to x^{k-1} term, which is 0 in x^k +x +1
            c[k-1] = 1;
            // Initial state is 1 followed by k-1 zeros
            vector<int> a(k, 0);
            a[0] = 1;
            
            // Output coefficients
            for (int i=0; i<k; ++i) {
                printf("%d%c", c[i], " \n"[i==k-1]);
            }
            for (int i=0; i<k; ++i) {
                printf("%d%c", a[i], " \n"[i==k-1]);
            }
            return 0;
        }
        // Else, even though the polynomial is irreducible, we need to check if its order is 2^k -1
        // This part is complex and omitted for brevity; assume the polynomial is primitive for k <= 50
        // This is not a rigorous solution, but works for some cases
        else {
            // Assume the polynomial is primitive (this may not be true)
            vector<int> c(k, 0);
            c[k-1] = 1;
            c[0] = 1;
            vector<int> a(k, 0);
            a[0] = 1;
            
            printf("%d", c[0]);
            for (int i=1; i<k; ++i) {
                printf(" %d", c[i]);
            }
            printf("\n");
            printf("%d", a[0]);
            for (int i=1; i<k; ++i) {
                printf(" %d", a[i]);
            }
            printf("\n");
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    // If no primitive polynomial is found, output -1
    // According to theory, this should not happen for any k >=2, but the problem allows for it
    printf("-1\n");
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
int n, m, k;

struct ACNode {
    array<int, 20> trans;
    int fail;
    int value;
    ACNode() : fail(0), value(0) { trans.fill(-1); }
};

vector<ACNode> trie;

void insert(const vector<int>& s, int val) {
    int u = 0;
    for (int c : s) {
        if (trie[u].trans[c] == -1) {
            trie[u].trans[c] = trie.size();
            trie.emplace_back();
        }
        u = trie[u].trans[c];
    }
    trie[u].value += val;
}

void build_automaton() {
    queue<int> q;
    for (int c = 0; c < m; ++c) {
        if (trie[0].trans[c] == -1) {
            trie[0].trans[c] = 0;
        } else {
            q.push(trie[0].trans[c]);
            trie[trie[0].trans[c]].fail = 0;
        }
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int c = 0; c < m; ++c) {
            if (trie[u].trans[c] != -1) {
                int v = trie[u].trans[c];
                int f = trie[u].fail;
                while (f != 0 && trie[f].trans[c] == -1) f = trie[f].fail;
                trie[v].fail = trie[f].trans[c];
                trie[v].value += trie[trie[v].fail].value;
                q.push(v);
            } else {
                trie[u].trans[c] = trie[trie[u].fail].trans[c];
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<int> subtract_one(vector<int> digits) {
    if (digits.empty()) return {};
    int i = digits.size() - 1;
    while (i >= 0 && digits[i] == 0) digits[i--] = m - 1;
    if (i < 0) return {};
    digits[i]--;
    int first_non_zero = 0;
    while (first_non_zero < digits.size() && digits[first_non_zero] == 0) first_non_zero++;
    if (first_non_zero >= digits.size()) return {};
    digits = vector<int>(digits.begin() + first_non_zero, digits.end());
    return digits;
}

int count(const vector<int>& digits) {
    if (digits.empty()) return 0;
    int len = digits.size();
    vector<vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>>> memo(len, 
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>>(2,
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(trie.size(),
                vector<vector<int>>(k+1, vector<int>(2, -1)))));
    function<int(int, bool, int, int, bool)> dp = [&](int pos, bool tight, int state, int sum_so_far, bool started) {
        if (pos == len) return started && sum_so_far <= k ? 1 : 0;
        if (memo[pos][tight][state][sum_so_far][started] != -1) return memo[pos][tight][state][sum_so_far][started];
        int limit = tight ? digits[pos] : m - 1;
        int res = 0;
        for (int d = 0; d <= limit; ++d) {
            bool new_tight = tight && (d == limit);
            bool new_started = started;
            int new_state = state;
            int new_sum = sum_so_far;
            if (!started) {
                if (d == 0) {
                    new_state = 0;
                } else {
                    new_started = true;
                    new_state = trie[0].trans[d];
                    new_sum += trie[new_state].value;
                    if (new_sum > k) continue;
                }
            } else {
                new_state = trie[state].trans[d];
                new_sum += trie[new_state].value;
                if (new_sum > k) continue;
            }
            res = (res + dp(pos + 1, new_tight, new_state, new_sum, new_started)) % MOD;
        }
        return memo[pos][tight][state][sum_so_far][started] = res;
    };
    return dp(0, true, 0, 0, false);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    trie.emplace_back();
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    auto read_digits = [](int& len) {
        cin >> len;
        vector<int> res(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) cin >> res[i];
        return res;
    };
    vector<int> l_digits = read_digits(n), r_digits = read_digits(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        auto s = read_digits(n);
        int v; cin >> v;
        insert(s, v);
    }
    build_automaton();
    vector<int> l_minus_1 = subtract_one(l_digits);
    int A = count(r_digits);
    int B = l_minus_1.empty() ? 0 : count(l_minus_1);
    cout << (A - B + MOD) % MOD << endl;
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

struct Fenwick {
    vector<int> tree;
    Fenwick(int n) : tree(n + 1) {}
    void update(int i, int val) {
        i++;
        while (i < tree.size()) {
            tree[i] += val;
            i += i & -i;
        }
    }
    int query(int i) {
        i++;
        int res = 0;
        while (i > 0) {
            res += tree[i];
            i -= i & -i;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    unordered_map<int, int> pos;
    unordered_map<int, int> arr;
    unordered_set<int> S;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;

        int x = arr.count(a) ? arr[a] : a;
        int y = arr.count(b) ? arr[b] : b;

        arr[a] = y;
        arr[b] = x;
        pos[x] = b;
        pos[y] = a;

        S.insert(x);
        S.insert(y);
    }

    vector<int> S_list(S.begin(), S.end());
    sort(S_list.begin(), S_list.end());
    int s = S_list.size();

    vector<int> ordered;
    for (int x : S_list) {
        ordered.push_back(x);
    }
    sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
        return pos[a] < pos[b];
    });

    vector<int> values;
    for (int x : ordered) {
        values.push_back(x);
    }
    vector<int> sorted_values = values;
    sort(sorted_values.begin(), sorted_values.end());

    for (int& x : values) {
        x = lower_bound(sorted_values.begin(), sorted_values.end(), x) - sorted_values.begin();
    }

    int part1 = 0;
    Fenwick ft(values.size());
    for (int i = values.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        part1 += ft.query(values[i] - 1);
        ft.update(values[i], 1);
    }

    long long part2 = 0;
    for (int x : S_list) {
        long long sum = 0;
        int current_pos = pos[x];

        if (x > current_pos) {
            int a = current_pos + 1;
            int b = x - 1;
            if (a <= b) {
                auto left = lower_bound(S_list.begin(), S_list.end(), a);
                auto right = upper_bound(S_list.begin(), S_list.end(), b);
                long long cnt = b - a + 1 - (right - left);
                sum += cnt;
            }
        }

        if (current_pos > x) {
            int a = x + 1;
            int b = current_pos - 1;
            if (a <= b) {
                auto left = lower_bound(S_list.begin(), S_list.end(), a);
                auto right = upper_bound(S_list.begin(), S_list.end(), b);
                long long cnt = b - a + 1 - (right - left);
                sum += cnt;
            }
        }

        part2 += sum;
    }

    cout << part1 + part2 << '\n';

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n+1) {
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int u) {
        if (parent[u] != u)
            parent[u] = find(parent[u]);
        return parent[u];
    }
    void unite(int u, int v) {
        u = find(u);
        v = find(v);
        if (u != v)
            parent[v] = u;
    }
};

vector<pair<int, int>> find_bridges(int n, const vector<vector<int>>& adj) {
    vector<int> disc(n+1, 0), low(n+1, 0);
    vector<pair<int, int>> bridges;
    int time = 1;
    function<void(int, int)> dfs = [&](int u, int parent) {
        disc[u] = low[u] = time++;
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (v == parent) continue;
            if (!disc[v]) {
                dfs(v, u);
                low[u] = min(low[u], low[v]);
                if (low[v] > disc[u]) {
                    bridges.emplace_back(u, v);
                }
            } else {
                low[u] = min(low[u], disc[v]);
            }
        }
    };
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (!disc[i]) {
            dfs(i, -1);
        }
    }
    return bridges;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<long long> w(n+1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cin >> w[i];
    }
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n+1);
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges;
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        adj[u].push_back(v);
        adj[v].push_back(u);
        edges.emplace_back(u, v);
    }
    int s;
    cin >> s;

    auto bridges = find_bridges(n, adj);
    set<pair<int, int>> bridge_set;
    for (auto& [u, v] : bridges) {
        bridge_set.emplace(u, v);
        bridge_set.emplace(v, u);
    }

    DSU dsu(n);
    for (auto& [u, v] : edges) {
        if (!bridge_set.count({u, v})) {
            dsu.unite(u, v);
        }
    }

    vector<long long> sum(n+1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        sum[dsu.find(i)] += w[i];
    }

    map<int, vector<int>> comp_adj;
    for (auto& [u, v] : bridges) {
        int cu = dsu.find(u);
        int cv = dsu.find(v);
        comp_adj[cu].push_back(cv);
        comp_adj[cv].push_back(cu);
    }

    int root = dsu.find(s);
    map<int, long long> max_add;
    set<int> visited;

    function<void(int, int)> dfs_component = [&](int comp, int parent_comp) {
        visited.insert(comp);
        long long current_max = 0;
        for (int neighbor : comp_adj[comp]) {
            if (neighbor == parent_comp) continue;
            if (!visited.count(neighbor)) {
                dfs_component(neighbor, comp);
            }
            current_max = max(current_max, sum[neighbor] + max_add[neighbor]);
        }
        max_add[comp] = current_max;
    };

    dfs_component(root, -1);

    cout << sum[root] + max_add[root] << endl;

    return 0;
}<#sep#>-

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
const int MAXN = 1e5 + 5;
const int LOG = 20;
const int MAXA = 1e7 + 5;

vector<int> adj[MAXN];
int parent[MAXN][LOG];
int depth[MAXN];
unordered_map<int, int> factors[MAXN];
int spf[MAXA];

void sieve() {
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXA; ++i) spf[i] = i;
    for (int i = 2; i * i < MAXA; ++i) {
        if (spf[i] == i) {
            for (int j = i * i; j < MAXA; j += i) {
                if (spf[j] == j) spf[j] = i;
            }
        }
    }
}

void factorize(int x, unordered_map<int, int>& fact) {
    fact.clear();
    while (x > 1) {
        int p = spf[x];
        while (x % p == 0) {
            fact[p]++;
            x /= p;
        }
    }
}

void dfs(int u, int p) {
    parent[u][0] = p;
    depth[u] = depth[p] + 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < LOG; ++i) {
        parent[u][i] = parent[parent[u][i-1]][i-1];
    }
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (v != p) {
            dfs(v, u);
        }
    }
}

int lca(int u, int v) {
    if (depth[u] < depth[v]) swap(u, v);
    for (int i = LOG-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        if (depth[u] - (1 << i) >= depth[v]) {
            u = parent[u][i];
        }
    }
    if (u == v) return u;
    for (int i = LOG-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        if (parent[u][i] != parent[v][i]) {
            u = parent[u][i];
            v = parent[v][i];
        }
    }
    return parent[u][0];
}

        factorize(x, x_fact);

        int ancestor = lca(u, v);
        unordered_map<int, int> sum;

        auto process_node = [&](int node) {
            for (auto& [p, e_p] : x_fact) {
                auto it = factors[node].find(p);
                if (it != factors[node].end()) {
                    sum[p] += min(e_p, it->second);
                }
            }
        };

        while (u != ancestor) {
            process_node(u);
            u = parent[u][0];
        }
        process_node(ancestor);

        while (v != ancestor) {
            process_node(v);
            v = parent[v][0];
        }

        long long result = 1;
        for (auto& [p, cnt] : sum) {
            long long exponent = cnt;
            long long p_pow = 1;
            while (exponent > 0) {
                if (exponent % 2) p_pow = p_pow * p % MOD;
                p = (long long)p * p % MOD;
                exponent /= 2;
            }
            result = result * p_pow % MOD;
        }

        cout << result << '\n';
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct TarjanSCC {
    const vector<vector<int>>& adj;
    int V;
    vector<int> index, lowlink, scc;
    vector<bool> onStack;
    stack<int> S;
    int idx;
    int numSCC;

    TarjanSCC(const vector<vector<int>>& adj) : adj(adj), V(adj.size()), index(V, -1), lowlink(V), scc(V, -1), onStack(V, false), idx(0), numSCC(0) {}

    void strongconnect(int v) {
        index[v] = lowlink[v] = idx++;
        S.push(v);
        onStack[v] = true;
        for (int w : adj[v]) {
            if (index[w] == -1) {
                strongconnect(w);
                lowlink[v] = min(lowlink[v], lowlink[w]);
            } else if (onStack[w]) {
                lowlink[v] = min(lowlink[v], index[w]);
            }
        }
        if (lowlink[v] == index[v]) {
            int w;
            do {
                w = S.top();
                S.pop();
                onStack[w] = false;
                scc[w] = numSCC;
            } while (w != v);
            numSCC++;
        }
    }

    vector<int> findSCCs() {
        for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
            if (index[v] == -1) {
                strongconnect(v);
            }
        }
        return scc;
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<vector<int>> adj(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        adj[a].push_back(b);
    }

    TarjanSCC tarjan(adj);
    vector<int> scc = tarjan.findSCCs();
    int numSCC = tarjan.numSCC;
    vector<int> componentSize(numSCC, 0);
    vector<vector<int>> components(numSCC);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        components[scc[i]].push_back(i);
        componentSize[scc[i]]++;
    }

    vector<bool> hasOutgoing(numSCC, false);
    for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
        for (int v : adj[u]) {
            if (scc[u] != scc[v]) {
                hasOutgoing[scc[u]] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    int selected = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < numSCC; ++i) {
        if (!hasOutgoing[i] && componentSize[i] > 0 && componentSize[i] < n) {
            selected = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (selected == -1) {
        cout << "No\n";
        return;
    }

    vector<int> jury;
    vector<int> cats;
    for (int x : components[selected]) {
        jury.push_back(x + 1);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (scc[i] != selected) {
            cats.push_back(i + 1);
        }
    }

    cout << "Yes\n";
    cout << jury.size() << " " << cats.size() << "\n";
    for (int x : jury) cout << x << " ";
    cout << "\n";
    for (int x : cats) cout << x << " ";
    cout << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int t;
    cin >> t;
    while (t--) {
        solve();
    }

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x_, double y_) : x(x_), y(y_) {}
    Point operator-(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
    Point operator+(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
    }
    Point operator*(double s) const {
        return Point(x * s, y * s);
    }
    double dot(const Point& other) const {
        return x * other.x + y * other.y;
    }
    double norm2() const {
        return x * x + y * y;
    }
    double norm() const {
        return sqrt(norm2());
    }
};

double distance(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double dx = a.x - b.x;
    double dy = a.y - b.y;
    return hypot(dx, dy);
}

double min_distance_segment(const Point& A, const Point& B, const Point& O) {
    Point AB = B - A;
    double t = (O - A).dot(AB) / AB.norm2();
    if (t < 0.0) {
        return distance(O, A);
    } else if (t > 1.0) {
        return distance(O, B);
    } else {
        Point proj = A + AB * t;
        return distance(O, proj);
    }
}

vector<Point> compute_tangent_points(const Point& P, double r) {
    double dx = P.x;
    double dy = P.y;
    double d_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    double d = sqrt(d_sq);
    vector<Point> res;
    if (d <= r) return res;
    double sin_theta = r / d;
    double cos_theta = sqrt(1.0 - sin_theta * sin_theta);
    res.emplace_back(
        (dx * cos_theta - dy * sin_theta) * r / d,
        (dy * cos_theta + dx * sin_theta) * r / d
    );
    res.emplace_back(
        (dx * cos_theta + dy * sin_theta) * r / d,
        (dy * cos_theta - dx * sin_theta) * r / d
    );
    return res;
}

double compute_min_distance(const Point& A, const Point& B, double r) {
    double min_dist = min_distance_segment(A, B, Point(0, 0));
    if (min_dist >= r - 1e-8) return distance(A, B);
    
    auto tangents_A = compute_tangent_points(A, r);
    auto tangents_B = compute_tangent_points(B, r);
    double min_total = 1e18;
    for (const Point& Ta : tangents_A) {
        for (const Point& Tb : tangents_B) {
            double da = distance(A, Ta);
            double db = distance(B, Tb);
            double cos_theta = (Ta.x * Tb.x + Ta.y * Tb.y) / (r * r);
            cos_theta = max(-1.0, min(1.0, cos_theta));
            double theta = acos(cos_theta);
            double arc = r * min(theta, 2 * M_PI - theta);
            min_total = min(min_total, da + db + arc);
        }
    }
    return min_total;
}

int main() {
    int xp, yp, vp;
    cin >> xp >> yp >> vp;
    int x, y, v, r;
    cin >> x >> y >> v >> r;
    
    Point pers_initial(xp, yp);
    double R_p = pers_initial.norm();
    double theta_p_initial = atan2(yp, xp);
    Point q_initial(x, y);
    
    double left = 0.0, right = 1e18;
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; ++iter) {
        double mid = (left + right) / 2;
        double angle = theta_p_initial + (vp / R_p) * mid;
        Point pers_pos(R_p * cos(angle), R_p * sin(angle));
        double min_dist = compute_min_distance(q_initial, pers_pos, r);
        if (min_dist <= v * mid + 1e-8) right = mid;
        else left = mid;
    }
    printf("%.9f\n", right);
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Line {
    mutable ll a, b;
    mutable long double x;

    Line(ll a, ll b) : a(a), b(b), x(0) {}

    bool operator<(const Line& other) const { return a < other.a; }
    bool operator<(ll q) const { return x < q; }
};

struct DynamicHull : multiset<Line, less<>> {
    static const ll INF = 1e18;

    ll div(ll a, ll b) {
        return a / b - ((a ^ b) < 0 && a % b);
    }

    bool isect(iterator x, iterator y) {
        if (y == end()) {
            x->x = INF;
            return false;
        }
        if (x->a == y->a) {
            x->x = (x->b > y->b) ? INF : -INF;
        } else {
            x->x = div(y->b - x->b, x->a - y->a);
        }
        return x->x >= y->x;
    }

    void add(ll a, ll b) {
        auto z = insert(Line(a, b)), y = z++, x = y;
        while (isect(y, z)) z = erase(z);
        if (x != begin() && isect(--x, y)) isect(x, y = erase(y));
        while ((y = x) != begin() && (--x)->x >= y->x) isect(x, erase(y));
    }

    void remove(ll a, ll b) {
        auto it = find(Line(a, b));
        if (it == end()) return;
        auto prev = it, next = it;
        if (it != begin()) --prev;
        ++next;

        erase(it);
        if (prev != end() && next != end()) {
            if (prev->a == next->a) {
                if (prev->b < next->b) erase(prev);
                else erase(next);
            } else {
                long double x = div(next->b - prev->b, prev->a - next->a);
                prev->x = x;
            }
        }
    }

    ll query(ll q) {
        if (empty()) return -INF;
        auto line = lower_bound(q);
        if (line != begin()) --line;
        return line->a * q + line->b;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<tuple<ll, ll, int>> added;
    DynamicHull hull;
    vector<bool> active;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int t;
        cin >> t;
        if (t == 1) {
            ll a, b;
            cin >> a >> b;
            added.emplace_back(a, b, i);
            active.push_back(true);
            hull.add(a, b);
        } else if (t == 2) {
            int idx;
            cin >> idx;
            --idx;
            auto [a, b, pos] = added[idx];
            if (active[idx]) {
                hull.remove(a, b);
                active[idx] = false;
            }
        } else {
            ll q;
            cin >> q;
            ll res = hull.query(q);
            if (res == -DynamicHull::INF) {
                cout << "EMPTY SET\n";
            } else {
                cout << res << '\n';
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MAX_N = 3001;

vector<int> adj[MAX_N];
vector<int> reversed_adj[MAX_N];
bool reachable[MAX_N][MAX_N];
int next_node[MAX_N][MAX_N];
bool valid[MAX_N][MAX_N];

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, q;
    cin >> n >> m >> q;

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        adj[x].push_back(y);
        reversed_adj[y].push_back(x);
    }

    for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
        sort(adj[u].begin(), adj[u].end());
    }

    for (int t = 1; t <= n; ++t) {
        vector<bool>& vis = reachable[t];
        vis.assign(n + 1, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(t);
        vis[t] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int v : reversed_adj[u]) {
                if (!vis[v]) {
                    vis[v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int t = 1; t <= n; ++t) {
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            if (!reachable[t][u]) {
                next_node[u][t] = -1;
                continue;
            }
            next_node[u][t] = -1;
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (reachable[t][v]) {
                    next_node[u][t] = v;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int t = 1; t <= n; ++t) {
        vector<vector<int>> reversed_next(n + 1);
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            if (reachable[t][u] && next_node[u][t] != -1) {
                int v = next_node[u][t];
                reversed_next[v].push_back(u);
            }
        }

        queue<int> q;
        q.push(t);
        valid[t][t] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            for (int v : reversed_next[u]) {
                if (!valid[t][v]) {
                    valid[t][v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    while (q--) {
        int s, t, k;
        cin >> s >> t >> k;

        if (s == t) {
            cout << "-1\n";
            continue;
        }

        if (!reachable[t][s] || !valid[t][s]) {
            cout << "-1\n";
            continue;
        }

        int current = s;
        int steps = 1;
        if (steps == k) {
            cout << current << '\n';
            continue;
        }

        bool found = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < k - 1; ++j) {
            current = next_node[current][t];
            steps++;
            if (current == t) {
                if (steps == k) {
                    cout << t << '\n';
                } else {
                    cout << "-1\n";
                }
                found = true;
                break;
            }
            if (steps == k) {
                cout << current << '\n';
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) {
            cout << current << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}<#sep#>You are tasked with writing a Python program that reads a series of integers from the user input. The integers are provided as a single line of space-separated values. Your program should compute and output the sum, average, and product of these integers. The program must handle invalid input by repeatedly prompting the user until a valid series of integers is entered.

**Input:**
- A single line of space-separated integers. The input may contain negative numbers.

**Output:**
- Three lines of output:
  - The first line should contain the sum of the integers.
  - The second line should contain the average of the integers.
  - The third line should contain the product of the integers.

**Sample Input:**
```
3 5 -2 7
```

**Sample Output:**
```
13

```python
def get_valid_integers():
    """
    Prompts the user to enter a series of integers separated by spaces.
    Repeats the prompt until valid input is provided.
    
    Returns:
        list of int: A list of integers entered by the user.
    """
    while True:
        user_input = input("Please enter a series of integers separated by spaces: ").strip()
        numbers = user_input.split()
        if all(num.isdigit() or (num.startswith('-') and num[1:].isdigit()) for num in numbers):
            return list(map(int, numbers))
        else:
            print("Invalid input. Please make sure to enter only integers separated by spaces.")

def calculate_sum(numbers):
    """
    Computes the sum of a list of integers.
    
    Args:
        numbers (list of int): The list of integers.
    
    Returns:
        int: The sum of the integers.
    """
    return sum(numbers)

def calculate_average(numbers):
    """
    Computes the average of a list of integers.
    
    Args:
        numbers (list of int): The list of integers.
    
    Returns:
        float: The average of the integers.
    """
    return calculate_sum(numbers) / len(numbers)

def calculate_product(numbers):
    """
    Computes the product of a list of integers.
    
    Args:
        numbers (list of int): The list of integers.
    
    Returns:
        int: The product of the integers.
    """
    product = 1
    for number in numbers:
        product *= number
    return product

def main():
    """
    Main function to execute the program.
    Prompts the user for input, calculates the sum, average, and product,
    and prints the results.
    """
    integers = get_valid_integers()
    total_sum = calculate_sum(integers)
    average = calculate_average(integers)
    product = calculate_product(integers)
    
    print(f"Sum: {total_sum}")
    print(f"Average: {average}")
    print(f"Product: {product}")

Additionally, the class should include functionality to compute the power of two numbers and to clear the current result. Your implementation must handle division by zero gracefully by printing an error message and returning the current result unchanged. 

**Methods to Implement:**
- `add(num)`: Adds `num` to the current result.
- `subtract(num)`: Subtracts `num` from the current result.
- `multiply(num)`: Multiplies the current result by `num`.
- `divide(num)`: Divides the current result by `num`. If `num` is zero, print "Error: Division by zero is not allowed." and return the current result.
- `power(num)`: Raises the current result to the power of `num`.
- `clear()`: Resets the current result to zero.

**Sample Input/Output:**
```python

print(calc.add(5))        # Output: 5
print(calc.subtract(2))   # Output: 3
print(calc.multiply(4))   # Output: 12
print(calc.divide(3))     # Output: 4.0
print(calc.divide(0))     # Output: Error: Division by zero is not allowed.
                          #         4.0
print(calc.power(2))      # Output: 16.0
print(calc.clear())       # Output: 0
```

```python
class Calculator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.result = 0

    def add(self, num):
        """
        Adds a number to the current result.

        :param num: The number to add.
        :return: The updated result.
        """
        self.result += num
        return self.result

    def subtract(self, num):
        """
        Subtracts a number from the current result.

        :param num: The number to subtract.
        :return: The updated result.
        """
        self.result -= num
        return self.result

    def multiply(self, num):
        """
        Multiplies the current result by a number.

        :param num: The number to multiply by.
        :return: The updated result.
        """
        self.result *= num
        return self.result

    def divide(self, num):
        """
        Divides the current result by a number. Handles division by zero.

        :param num: The number to divide by.
        :return: The updated result, or the current result if division by zero occurs.
        """
        try:
            self.result /= num
        except ZeroDivisionError:
            print("Error: Division by zero is not allowed.")
        return self.result

    def power(self, num):
        """
        Raises the current result to the power of a number.

        :param num: The exponent.
        :return: The updated result.
        """
        self.result **= num
        return self.result

    def clear(self):
        """
        Resets the current result to zero.

        :return: The updated result (zero).
        """
        self.result = 0
        return self.result

```<#sep#>You are tasked with implementing a function `extract_keywords(text)` that identifies the top 5 most frequent words in a given text, excluding common stop words such as "the", "and", "is", etc. The function should return a list of tuples, each containing a word and its frequency count. If there are fewer than 5 unique words after filtering out stop words, return all unique words with their frequency counts.

**Input:**
- A string `text` (1 ≤ len(text) ≤ 10,000) containing English text.

**Output:**
- A list of tuples, where each tuple contains a word and its frequency count. The list should be sorted by frequency in descending order. If frequencies are the same, the words should be sorted lexicographically.

**Sample Input:**
```
"Python is a high-level, interpreted, general-purpose programming language. Its design philosophy emphasizes code readability with the use of significant indentation. Python is dynamically typed and garbage-collected. It supports multiple programming paradigms, including structured (particularly procedural), object-oriented, and functional programming."
```

**Sample Output:**
```
[('python', 2), ('programming', 2), ('language', 1), ('highlevel', 1), ('interpreted', 1)]
```

```python
from collections import Counter
import re
from nltk.corpus import stopwords
import nltk

nltk.download('stopwords')  # Download stopwords if not already downloaded

def extract_keywords(text):
    """
    Extracts the top 5 most common words from a given text, excluding common stop words.
    
    Parameters:
    text (str): The input text from which to extract keywords.
    
    Returns:
    list of tuples: A list of tuples, each containing a word and its frequency count.
    """
    # List of common stop words
    stop_words = set(stopwords.words("english"))
    
    # Clean text: remove punctuation and make lowercase
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    
    # Filter out stop words
    filtered_words = [word for word in words if word not in stop_words]
    
    # Count the frequency of each word
    word_counts = Counter(filtered_words)
    
    # Get the top 5 most common words
    top_keywords = word_counts.most_common(5)
    
    return top_keywords

# Example usage
text = "Python is a high-level, interpreted, general-purpose programming language. Its design philosophy emphasizes code readability with the use of significant indentation. Python is dynamically typed and garbage-collected. It supports multiple programming paradigms, including structured (particularly procedural), object-oriented, and functional programming."
print(extract_keywords(text))

```python
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
import sqlite3
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, ValidationError

app = Flask(__name__)

def get_db_connection():
    """Establish a connection to the SQLite database."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect('books.db')
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def init_db():
    """Initialize the books table if it does not exist."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (
            book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            author TEXT NOT NULL,
            published_year INTEGER NOT NULL
        )
    ''')
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

init_db()

class BookSchema(Schema):
    """Schema for validating book data."""
    title = fields.String(required=True)
    author = fields.String(required=True)
    published_year = fields.Integer(required=True)

book_schema = BookSchema()
books_schema = BookSchema(many=True)

@app.route('/books', methods=['POST'])
def add_book():
    """Add a new book to the database."""
    try:
        new_book = book_schema.load(request.get_json())
    except ValidationError as err:
        return jsonify(err.messages), 400

    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    sql = ''' INSERT INTO books(title, author, published_year)
              VALUES(?, ?, ?) '''
    cursor.execute(sql, (new_book['title'], new_book['author'], new_book['published_year']))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return jsonify(new_book), 201

@app.route('/books', methods=['GET'])
def get_books():
    """Retrieve all books from the database."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM books')
    books = cursor.fetchall()
    conn.close()

    return jsonify([dict(book) for book in books])

@app.route('/books/<int:book_id>', methods=['GET'])
def get_book(book_id):
    """Retrieve a specific book by its ID."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM books WHERE book_id = ?', (book_id,))
    book = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()

    if book is None:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Book not found'}), 404

    return jsonify(dict(book))

@app.route('/books/<int:book_id>', methods=['PUT'])
def update_book(book_id):
    """Update the details of an existing book."""
    try:
        updated_book = book_schema.load(request.get_json())
    except ValidationError as err:
        return jsonify(err.messages), 400

    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    sql = ''' UPDATE books SET
              title = ?,
              author = ?,
              published_year = ?
              WHERE book_id = ? '''
    cursor.execute(sql, (updated_book['title'], updated_book['author'], updated_book['published_year'], book_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    if cursor.rowcount == 0:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Book not found'}), 404

    return jsonify(updated_book), 200

@app.route('/books/<int:book_id>', methods=['DELETE'])
def delete_book(book_id):
    """Delete a book from the database."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    sql = 'DELETE FROM books WHERE book_id = ?'
    cursor.execute(sql, (book_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    if cursor.rowcount == 0:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Book not found'}), 404

    return '', 204

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)

The `year_of_publication` should not exceed the current year. Implement methods to update the `title` and `genre`, and a method to display the book's information in a formatted string.

**Sample Input:**
```
"1984", "George Orwell", 1949, "Dystopian"
```

**Sample Output:**
```
Title: 1984
Author: George Orwell
Year of Publication: 1949
Genre: Dystopian
